jobs.description:
Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist

Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

About the Role

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.

This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication, with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling

  • Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.

  • Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

  • Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.

  • Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.

  • Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

  • Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.

  • Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.

  • Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

  • Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.

  • Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.

  • Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

  • Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.

  • Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.

  • Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

  • Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.

  • Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment, including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.

  • Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.

  • Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.

  • Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

How you communicate and connect with people.

How you present yourself professionally.

Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Sourcing Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Our Mid-Market Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

You’ll manage a portfolio of 100-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid-Market your reach and prioritize where you spend your time. You won’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves on integrations and the more technical aspects of the Samsara platform — you’ll learn, understand, and convey the value of our most complex products and features.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. The Mid-Market CS team is still being built, and you’ll help write its next chapter — shaping the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how we Mid-Market.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage a portfolio of ~100-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid-Market your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities — including its more technical and integration-related features — and explain them to businesses of all types: field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
  • Help build the next chapter of Mid-Market CS at Samsara by contributing to the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how the team Mid-Markets.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2 - 4+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, sales, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering leadership, and day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working on a Renewal + Growth Quota
  • Has a strong bias for action, the ability to think big, and insistence on high standards.
  • Has experience serving and supporting large-Mid-Market business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort with APIs and integrations.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$65,598.75—$88,200 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Location: Fully Remote, United States

Position Type: Full-Time

Clearance: U.S. citizenship is required. The candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain federal suitability, a government-issued PIV credential, and required system access.

The Opportunity

TeamWorx Security is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to develop analytical and AI-enabled capabilities on a federal enterprise data modernization effort. The Senior Data Scientist will work with business teams, technical staff, and government stakeholders to turn mission questions into analytical approaches, build and validate models on governed enterprise data, and deliver results decision-makers can act on and defend.

The work spans multiple business lines, so priorities shift as different teams need help. This role rewards someone who can move between problem domains, learn a new business area quickly, and apply the method that best fits the stakeholder's or end-user's question.

Success in this role requires initiative, ownership, and clear communication. You will work through ambiguity, identify needs or risks before they become problems, and move work forward without waiting for detailed direction.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Translate mission and business questions into analytical approaches, working directly with government stakeholders and subject matter experts to define the problem before modeling it.
  • Perform exploratory and statistical analysis, predictive modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, and feature engineering using governed enterprise data.
  • Develop, validate, and maintain models and AI-enabled analytical capabilities, including documented assumptions, definitions, and data lineage, and establish whether the outputs are accurate, explainable, and fit for the decision being supported.
  • Build the analytical datasets your work depends on using Databricks, BigQuery, Python, and SQL, working with the data engineering team where production pipelines are required.
  • Take ownership of existing analytical products, reports, and stakeholder relationships, sustaining and improving them while building new capabilities.
  • Deliver results as visualizations, dashboards, models, and written analysis that technical and non-technical audiences can both use, and present findings to stakeholders and leadership.

What We Think You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree with 12 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 10 years, in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, operations research, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, validating, and documenting analytical models that informed real operational or business decisions.
  • Strong applied statistics and machine learning fundamentals, including judgment about which method fits the problem.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for analysis, modeling, and working with data at scale.
  • Experience evaluating model performance and communicating uncertainty, limitations, and assumptions honestly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience working in Databricks as a practitioner: notebooks, SQL and PySpark for analysis, model development and tracking, AI features, or dashboards.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting GSA, ideally within the Public Buildings Service, including an understanding of how PBS is organized, how its business lines operate, and where its data lives.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery, along with familiarity with data governance and production support.
  • Experience as the senior analytical voice on a team, setting methods, reviewing others' analysis, and mentoring less experienced analysts.

What’s in it for you?

These awesome perks: Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Life Insurance, Matching 401(k) Contributions, Paid Time Off including 11 Holidays and your Birthday, Professional Development, Fitness Membership, and Home Office allocations, Performance Bonuses & Profit Sharing, & Employee Referral Bonuses. But wait, there's more: TeamWorx Security is committed to our teammates and their professional goals. Being a small but growing company affords us the opportunity to work WITH YOU to reach your full potential.

A Little About Us and Our Team

We love to be inspired. We started TeamWorx Security to build, create, and dream about what inspires us, and because of this, our Maryland startup is quickly growing. We are a team of data scientists, software engineers, researchers, product developers, and operation-minded folks who specialize in developing applications and products that our customers love. Our mission is to reinvent the way technical and non-technical people work with technology. We believe in creating harmonious, automated solutions designed to improve our customers’ daily workflow, allowing them to act quickly and decisively about what matters most. We are looking for critical thinkers who excel at solving problems and have a passion for what they do to help us move our mission forward. This is our story; come tell us your story.

At TeamWorx Security, Inc., we hold our values as guiding principles in all that we do and encourage our community to embrace and embody them. Our core values are putting our employees first, being curious, being authentic, being scrappy, and honoring those we serve. These values drive our company culture, decision-making, and operations.

Commitment to Our Talent Community

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

AI Leadership & Productivity

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.

As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP.

About the role

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams.

You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself.

You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate.

What you'll do

  • Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

  • Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker.

  • Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it.

  • Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

  • Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach.

  • Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

  • Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and with the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made.

  • For customers without a Customer Success Manager, act as the escalation point for SLA breaches and own continuity of operations.

  • Direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts.

What we're really looking for

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Process Excellence – You understand core business processes deeply, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

  • Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

  • Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You separate a configuration symptom from a process cause, and pick the right lever for each.

What you'll bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, process improvement, shared services, or ERP process ownership.

  • Deep working knowledge of at least one core business process end to end, purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash. This is a prerequisite, not a nice to have.

  • Demonstrable experience changing how a finance, procurement or supply chain team actually works, not only advising on it.

  • Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable working with process and transaction data directly.

  • Confident facilitating workshops with operational teams and presenting to their leadership.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, accounts payable or order management processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

What you'll get

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

Location: Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only - supporting a team in the EST time zone.

About the role

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or .

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

  • 3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.

  • You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.

  • You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus.

  • You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.

  • You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role.

  • You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.

  • You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.

  • You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.

  • You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.

  • You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.

  • You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.

  • Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

A day in the life

  • Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.

  • Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.

  • Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.

  • Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.

  • Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.

  • Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.

  • Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.

  • Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of applied data science and AI product quality for a small, fast-moving AI productivity startup building autonomous agents that handle email, calendar, browser, and business software tasks. You will own the measurement of agent quality end-to-end: turning ambiguous product behavior into rigorous, actionable evaluation systems that directly guide engineering and product decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and maintain automated evaluation pipelines that measure agent quality across capabilities and product surfaces.

  • Translate agent capabilities into explicit success criteria, including pass, partial-pass, and failure definitions for complex multi-step tasks.

  • Build representative gold datasets and regression suites covering common workflows, edge cases, ambiguous requests, and adversarial scenarios.

  • Define and track metrics such as task success, tool-selection accuracy, instruction adherence, factual consistency, latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Design deterministic and model-based graders, calibrate LLM-as-a-judge systems, and measure grader agreement, false positives, and false negatives.

  • Analyze traces, tool calls, model outputs, and production outcomes to identify root causes and build a useful failure taxonomy.

  • Compare models, prompts, tools, and capability implementations using rigorous offline experiments and production evidence.

  • Build dashboards and release-quality signals that make evaluation results understandable and actionable for engineering, product, and leadership.

  • Partner with capability engineers to recommend improvements and verify that fixes raise quality without unacceptable regressions in cost, latency, or reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in data science, machine learning, or analytics roles, with a focus on evaluation systems, metrics frameworks, or quality measurement for production systems.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks, grading systems, and success criteria for ML or AI systems in production.

  • Strong Python and SQL proficiency with the ability to build automated data pipelines and production-quality analysis code at scale.

  • Solid statistical and experimental design knowledge: sampling, variance, uncertainty quantification, bias detection, confounding variables, and significance testing for non-deterministic systems.

  • Experience with ground-truth data development: labeling guideline design, annotation quality control, ambiguity resolution, and dataset maintenance.

  • Working knowledge of LLM behavior, tool use, retrieval systems, multi-step execution, and practical failure modes of language model systems.

  • Ability to connect quantitative patterns to individual system traces and identify failure origins across model, prompt, context, tools, data, and application logic.

  • Experience communicating evaluation results, methodology, uncertainty, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort operating with high ownership in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, independently turning open-ended quality questions into evaluation systems.

  • Experience with LLM-as-a-judge systems, agentic or multi-step task evaluation, or benchmarking platforms for AI systems is a strong plus.

Location

On-site in Palo Alto, California, United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

jobs.description:
About Sidekick

At Sidekick, we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

The role

A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.

What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.

You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.

You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.

What you'll do

  • Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.
  • Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.
  • Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.
  • Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.
  • Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.
  • Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)
  • Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.
  • Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.
  • You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in
  • Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page
  • Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof
  • Experience briefing editors or creators
  • Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about

We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.
  • Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries
  • You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results
  • You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast
  • Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Work from home

jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a six-month internship based at our HQ in central Zurich or in Munich. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely.

About the role

Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day.
This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day.

Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next.

You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them.

The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now.

This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses.

How we think about ownership
You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously.

Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job.

This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn.

What you'll do

  • Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from.

  • Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed.

  • Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected.

  • Adjust configuration where that is the right fix.

  • Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence.

  • Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows.

  • Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly.

  • Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice.

What we're really looking for

We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things.

  • Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does.

  • Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply.

  • Customer Nerve – You stay calm and credible with a frustrated controller on the phone, and you can say "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."

  • Self-Driven – You close your own knowledge gaps without being told to.

  • Ownership – You see things through without someone checking, and you know when to pull someone in.

What you'll bring

  • Enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in business, economics, information systems, engineering, computer science, or something adjacent. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome to make their case.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data.

  • Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run.

  • Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling.

Where it leads

Our internship is the main entry point into the delivery organisation. Interns who do well are offered a permanent role, most often as a Customer Success Engineer or as an AI Automation Specialist, and from there the paths into Consulting and into project management are well travelled. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming.

What you'll get

  • Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing.

  • A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems.

  • Direct access to engineers, product managers, and the people running our customers' finance operations.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client builds the data layer that AI agents run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, structured, LLM-ready data. It is already the default way a huge number of developers pull web data into their AI systems.

The numbers back it up: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled that in year two, and 125,000+ GitHub stars. They just closed a $75M Series B. The company is small, moving fast, and hiring people who want to build the next chapter with them.

The Mission

They believe developers and AI agents should not have to fight the web to get useful data out of it. Every hour spent maintaining a scraper, dealing with stale pages, or working around brittle retrieval systems is an hour taken away from the actual product.

Their job is to make that problem disappear: give AI systems reliable access to the live web, then make the results clean, current, structured, and useful enough to power real products.

The Opportunity

As a Search Engineer, you will own the systems that turn the open web into a high-quality search index.

You will work directly with the Head of Search and a small team to build and improve the crawling, indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving infrastructure behind a fast-growing search product. This is an end-to-end role: you will improve relevance while solving the real constraints of search at scale - freshness, deduplication, latency, reliability, and cost per query.

The key requirement is direct production ownership of ranking and relevance. You should be able to point to a search-quality change you personally shipped and the metric it improved.

What You’ll Do

  • Own ranking quality and relevance for LLM-driven search and retrieval

  • Build and operate the crawling, indexing, retrieval, and search-serving systems behind the product.

  • Improve search quality using lexical, semantic, hybrid, and reranking approaches

  • Reduce latency and cost per query as query volume and corpus size grow, without compromising relevance, correctness, or reliability

  • Own systems end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, measure, and iterate in production

  • Solve for freshness, incremental indexing, deduplication, crawl scheduling, and large-scale corpus management

  • Work directly with the Head of Search and the team to shape the roadmap and ship customer-facing improvements quickly

What You Bring

  • 3+ years building and operating production search or retrieval systems, with direct ownership of ranking and relevance

  • A specific example of a ranking or reranking change you owned and the measurable impact it had on relevance, recall, conversion, CTR, NDCG, MRR, or a similar metric

  • Hands-on information-retrieval depth across BM25/lexical, semantic/vector, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and retrieval or RAG evaluation

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems skills in Go, Rust, Python, or a comparable language, with end-to-end production ownership

  • Experience improving latency and cost at meaningful query volume while maintaining quality and reliability

  • Familiarity with search and infrastructure tooling such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP, gRPC, or Protobuf

Key Success Drivers

The people who do well here have personally owned search quality in production, think end-to-end about relevance, crawling, indexing, serving, latency, and cost, and thrive in ambiguity by shipping, measuring, and iterating quickly without needing a fully defined playbook.

Why Join?

  • Compensation & Equity: Base salary of $235K-$260K+. Meaningful equity in a fast-growing, well-funded startup

  • Traction: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled in year two. 125,000+ GitHub stars and a developer base showing up before you even start selling to them. $75M Series B closed in 2026, backed by top-tier investors

  • Team: ~40 people total, real visibility with the founders and leadership. No layers, no committees, fast decisions, short feedback loops

  • Benefits: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision (50% for spouse and kids); employer-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance; 401(k), pre-tax FSA, and commuter benefits; pet insurance; 15+ days PTO; 12 weeks fully paid parental leave for moms and dads; $100/month wellness stipend; $1,000/year learning and development budget; 3-month paid sabbatical after 4 years; team offsites twice a year; SF HQ perks and a loaner e-bike for commuting

  • Visa: not open to visa sponsorship on this one (US citizens and Green Card holders only).

  3. Founders Chat

  4. Paid Work Trial

  • Familiarity with SMS marketing platforms (Attentive, Postscript, or Klaviyo SMS).

Csatlakozz lendületes és sokszínű Értékesítési csapatunkhoz, ahol minden nap azon dolgozunk, hogy ügyfeleink a lehető legjobb szolgáltatásban részesüljenek. Ez a pozíció kifejezetten a magyarországi független értékesítők és üzleti partnereik támogatására fókuszál. Többféle kommunikációs csatornán keresztül segítjük őket abban, hogy jobban megismerjék termékeinket, és minél hamarabb megoldást találjanak a felmerülő kérdéseikre. Mindig meghallgatjuk javaslataikat, és figyelembe vesszük, hogyan fejlődhetünk cégként – legyen szó folyamataink újragondolásáról vagy belső rendszereink fejlesztéséről.

Feladataid közé tartozna:

  • Nagy mennyiségű beérkező hívás, e-mail és chat kezelése

  • Első szintű ügyféltámogatás nyújtása, a független értékesítők kérdéseinek megválaszolása és problémáik megoldásának elősegítése

  • Szoros együttműködés a KYC csapattal annak érdekében, hogy a kereskedők jogi és megfelelőségi folyamatai gördülékenyen működjenek

  • Pontos és naprakész nyilvántartás vezetése, frissítések rögzítése az adatbázisban

  • Az értékesítési folyamat nyomon követése, időben történő emlékeztetők és utánkövetések küldése az értékesítési csapatnak

  • A dokumentáció precíz, határidőre történő vezetése, a belső szabályzatok és iparági sztenderdek szerint

  • Panaszok kezelése, szükség esetén továbbítása a felsővezetés felé

A Te történeted

Szívesen tanulsz és fejlődsz velünk, miközben a saját szakértelmeddel is hozzájárulsz ahhoz, hogy ügyfeleink igényeit a lehető legjobban kielégítsük. Szeretsz másoknak támogatást nyújtani, és kész vagy mindig egy lépéssel többet tenni az ügyfelekért. Kiemelkedő kommunikációs készségeid vannak, és folyékonyan beszélsz magyarul és angolul.

  • Magabiztosan kezeled a felmerülő akadályokat.

  • Erősséged, hogy gyorsan megtalálod a közös hangot bárkivel, és könnyen építesz kapcsolatokat.

  • Előnyt jelent, ha korábbi szakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel értékesítési támogatás, ügyfélszolgálat vagy adminisztratív területen.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Amit kínálunk:

  • Versenyképes fizetés

  • Csapatépítő rendezvények és tevékenységek az irodában és azon kívül

  • Barátságos, kényelmes és informális irodai környezet

  • AYCM Sporting Pass, amely országszerte több száz sportlétesítményhez biztosít hozzáférést

  • SZÉP kártya

  • Utazási támogatás

  • Magánegészségügyi biztosítás

  • Évi három extra szabadnap

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre, kérjük, hogy jelezd felénk. Elkötelezettek vagyunk amellett, hogy a jelentkezési folyamat mindenki számára elérhető legyen.

jobs.description:
About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

About The Role

Chainlink Labs is hiring an Institutional Relations Lead to build and run a disciplined institutional relations function for the Chainlink ecosystem. This is a newly created, senior individual contributor role with a clear and commercially critical mandate: Build and own Chainlink's relationships with sell-side research analysts, create institutional-grade content that drives informed coverage of Chainlink, and support broader marketing efforts to the institutional community.

This is a "build" role, not maintenance; you will own the narrative that institutions and capital-markets counterparties hear about Chainlink, constructing the strategy, materials, and relationships from scratch.

The successful candidate must navigate the distinctions among Chainlink Labs, the decentralised Chainlink Network, communicating these nuances to a sophisticated audience spanning traditional asset managers, crypto-native funds, and sovereign institutions.

Your Impact

Analyst Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain a structured coverage program for sell-side research analysts at firms covering crypto, fintech, and digital assets.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact between Chainlink Labs and the sell-side analyst community

  • Proactively brief analysts regarding major announcements, protocol upgrades, and partnership milestones.

  • Facilitate access to Chainlink Labs' executive team and technical leadership for deep-dive analyst sessions.

  • Track analyst sentiment, coverage gaps, and broader digital asset research coverage — and report findings to executive leadership.

Investment Content Creation

  • Author institutional-grade research content including white papers, deep-dives, tokenomics explainers, newsletters, and blogs.

  • Translate complex protocol mechanics, on-chain data, and revenue models into clear, compelling narratives for institutions.

  • Develop a regular cadence of public-facing materials — quarterly data packets, use case briefings, and market positioning updates — that analysts and allocators can reference and cite.

  • Partner with internal teams (product, economics, legal) to ensure all content is accurate, approved, and consistent with Chainlink's public positioning.

Institutional Investor Engagement

  • Support the broader institutional strategy by engaging directly with accredited audiences who engage with digital assets.

  • Contribute to building and maintaining a CRM of qualified institutional and accredited contacts.

  • Collaborate with the PR function to secure podcast appearances, financial media placements, and speaking opportunities that reinforce the institutional narrative.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in investor relations, institutional research, investment banking, equity sales, or capital-markets roles, with significant direct experience engaging institutional investors.

  • Demonstrated experience engaging directly with sell-side equity research analysts — either as a peer analyst or as the company-side IR professional managing those relationships.

  • Exceptional written communication skills with a proven ability to produce institutional-grade content: research notes, white papers, or investor presentations that have been read and acted on by accredited audiences.

  • Deep understanding of how institutional investment decisions are made and how sell-side research influences allocator behaviour.

  • Genuine fluency in digital assets, blockchain technology, and token economics. You need to be able to speak credibly about staking mechanics and protocol revenue to generalist managers.

  • Existing relationships with sell-side analysts who cover crypto, fintech, or digital asset companies

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building a function from scratch within a globally distributed organisation.

Preferred Requirements

  • Prior experience as a sell-side equity research analyst, particularly covering fintech, payments infrastructure, or digital assets.

  • Experience at a crypto-native company or strong knowledge of DeFi.

  • Familiarity with the institutional digital asset landscape — who the major players are, how they think about digital assets, and what drives their decisions.

  • CFA or equivalent financial credentials.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on AI architecture research to help design, analyze, and advance next-generation model architectures.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on AI architecture research to help design, analyze, and advance next-generation model architectures. You’ll work at the intersection of theory and production—publishing novel research while collaborating closely with engineers to turn ideas into real systems.

This role is ideal for someone who has published research papers and wants to see their work directly shape deployed models, not just benchmarks.

What You’ll Work On

  • Research and design novel AI architectures (e.g. alternatives to standard Transformer designs, long-context models, efficient sequence modeling, hybrid architectures)

  • Explore architectural improvements for scalability, efficiency, and stability

  • Prototype and evaluate new architectures through ablations, benchmarks, and empirical studies

  • Author and co-author research papers for top ML conferences and journals

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to translate research into training and inference systems

  • Stay current with state-of-the-art research and identify promising directions early

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning research, with a focus on model architecture

  • Publication record in ML/AI venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, COLM, ACL, EMNLP, arXiv)

  • Deep understanding of:

    • Neural network architectures

    • Sequence models and attention mechanisms

    • Training dynamics and optimization

  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch or JAX

  • Ability to reason rigorously, design clean experiments, and communicate results clearly

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with non-Transformer architectures (e.g. RNN-based, state-space, hybrid models)

  • Work on long-context or memory-efficient models

  • Open-source research contributions

  • Experience bridging research and production systems

  • Background in efficient training or inference-aware architecture design

Why Join Us

  • High ownership over research direction and roadmap

  • Clear path to publishing impactful work

  • Tight feedback loop between research and real-world deployment

  • Small, highly technical team with strong research culture

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
