jobs.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are looking for a highly analytical, commercially-minded Associate Director who is motivated by the challenge of building a retention program for a high-growth consumer technology company. You will lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to drive subscriber growth and revenue, and partner with cross-functional colleagues to go deeper on customer behavior — with a specific focus on activation, loyalty, and long-term customer value.

You are building this program from the ground up rather than optimizing one that already exists. The list starts near 20,000 and scales rapidly behind a significant acquisition investment. Sending volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and increasingly granular segmentation is what drives that output. Automation is the engine: lead capture, welcome series, and the first-conversion funnel come first, then subscription activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase. The program runs on enterprise tooling — Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable.

You own the top-line retention revenue number for your client. You build the forecast, defend it, and lead the team that hits it.

We are open to candidates in NYC, NJ, Florida and Texas.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a growth marketer first and a lifecycle marketer second. You think in cohorts, conversion rates, and payback periods. You are energized by a program that does not exist yet and a list that is about to grow 10x.

  • 7+ years of experience in digital, growth, or lifecycle marketing, including time spent on subscription or SaaS products.

  • You have owned a revenue or subscriber target and built the forecast behind it — you can model list growth, conversion, activation, and churn and explain what moves each one.

  • You have scaled a lifecycle program through a period of rapid list growth, and you know what breaks when volume goes from a handful of sends to 40–60 per month.

  • You have built the funnel that matters here: lead capture, welcome series, first conversion, and subscription activation. You know the difference between a welcome flow that greets people and one that converts them.

  • You are fluent in subscription economics — trial-to-paid, activation, free-to-paid, upgrade and downgrade paths, involuntary churn, and win-back.

  • You have developed loyalty, referral, or rewards programming that measurably improved repeat purchase and LTV. Driving loyalty and repeat purchase is a core outcome of this role, not a side project.

  • You have worked in an enterprise-grade ESP such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or , and you understand what these platforms make possible: complex segmentation, event-driven journeys, in-app and push alongside email, and integration with a real product data stream.

  • You love making data-driven decisions and excel at turning analysis into lifecycle strategy that drives revenue. You are comfortable building the reporting yourself when you need to.

  • You are used to a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple workstreams for yourself, your team, and your client.

  • You have had at least one direct report before, or exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to articulate complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people at any level.

  • You dedicate time to staying on the cutting edge of consumer technology, subscription, and lifecycle marketing.

A day in the life

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for your client, meeting weekly to review performance and shape current and future initiatives.

  • Own the retention revenue forecast — build it, update it, and bring the recommendations that close any gap to plan.

  • Set the segmentation and lifecycle strategy that drives the program's output, and prioritize the roadmap of flows, campaigns, and tests behind it.

  • Own subscription activation and retention: the trial and onboarding journeys, the conversion moments, and the loyalty, repeat purchase, and win-back programming that extends customer lifetime.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with your direct reports, manage workload and capacity, and train the team to help them grow into experts.

  • Develop the strategic campaign calendar and partner with your specialists to deliver it at volume.

  • Review all client briefs and creative for approval before they reach the client.

  • Set the client's KPI framework and work with the team to turn results into insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams so that acquisition investment and lifecycle programming reinforce each other.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $100,000-$120,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.excerpt: We’re seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps with GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Go.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

Nice to have

  • Familiar with working in monorepos.

  • Experience with Change Data Capture.

  • Experience with IoT devices and sensors.

  • Digital signal processing experience.

  • Geospatial analysis and GIS experience.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Compensation

$100,000 - $150,000 CAD

Responsible for ensuring effective decision making when presented multiple options for how to progress with the project. Oversee dependencies across program tasks. Manages other project managers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Owns all aspects of 1 high complexity or 2 or more medium complexity programs, to deliver approved business functionality to Sysco.

  • Defines and leads program scope, approach, program-level assumptions, dependencies, risk, and budget.

  • Partners with all stakeholders and dependent projects and programs to develop detailed program schedules. Coordinates activities, critical dates, and dependencies across multiple distinct projects/programs.

  • Prepares financial plans showing profiled capital and revenue expenditure. Defines financial reporting requirements and arrangements for the release of funding linked to stage or phase gates. Establishes budget governance processes at the program level to drive efficiency and timely completion of initiatives.

  • Oversees project budget, including purchases and contracts, monthly spend and resource forecasting. Seek cost-effective alternatives to enhance cost efficiency while delivering quality results. Conducts and supervises financial processes such as budgeting, forecasting, and correct coding of actual expenses.

  • Supervises creation of purchase requisitions and onboarding third-party resources to specific programs.

  • Leads the development of the Business Case, in alignment with senior stakeholders and obtaining agreement through approving governance bodies. Collaborates with financial business partners and leadership team to support IT business case creation.

  • Identifies and monitors program risks (threats and opportunities), planning and implementing responses to them and responding to other issues impacting the program.

  • Manages risks and issues, including those that are strategic and politically sensitive, ensuring regular reporting and escalation as appropriate. Serves as final point of escalation in remediation of risks, issues, or requests. Evaluates impact of scope changes on the program(s) and how they may interact with other projects.

  • Drives communications between stakeholders of dependent projects and with Sysco management.

  • Identifies, addresses, and resolves differences between individuals and/or stakeholder interest groups using conflict management techniques.

  • Mentor and train project and program managers in their technical and professional development. Identify and coordinate training needs.

  • Map program dependencies and identify owners, build dependency management into the program's governance cycle.

  • Defines quality indicators for processes/outputs and manages quality assurance and control processes for projects/programs. Uses these to determine whether success criteria are met, capture lessons learned, and implement change control processes.

  • Independently creates and supervises reporting flows and processes for multiple projects/teams/workstreams in a program. May manage other project management members of the team.

MANDATORY EXPERIENCE

  • 10 years project management experience in a project or program management role.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience with project management tools and methodology.

  • Demonstrated understanding of project financials and measures of performance.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • CAPM/PMP, Prince 2 or similar certification. Experience with Agile Methodology or CSM certification preferred.

  • 10 years' experience with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet or PlanView.

  • Strong Proficiency in Schedule Management, Budget & Cost Control, Forecasting & Budget Reporting, Project Governance & Reporting, Risk & Issue Management, Change Control, Stakeholder Management, Project Metrics & Measurement, Quality Management,

  • Exhibits adaptability by maintaining agility when faced with unexpected challenges and models resiliency when facing obstacles. Develops/refines best practices that can account for known gaps in information sharing and rapidly changing business needs. Able to apply a broad range of project management approaches despite ambiguity and recommends appropriate actions for others.

  • Ensures program alignment with the organization's overarching governance structure and aligns relevant individuals on their respective roles and responsibilities. Ensures clarity and consistency of governance structures and staffing throughout project/program lifetime

  • Holds self and others accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost-effective results.

  • Can determine objectives, set priorities, and delegate work. Outlines goals and assesses workgroup progress towards goal achievement. Empowers team to achieve targets.

  • Conducts complex financial analysis to support project/program decision-making and provides well-rounded recommendations for adjusting business decisions and strategies within a project/program. Review/approve budgets and forecasts that are prepared by junior level leaders.

  • Uses negotiation and influencing skills to agree on a schedule of requirements with stakeholders, document these requirements, and refine them as needed, with appropriate change control process implementation.

  • Supports and reviews creation of project/program artifacts by junior colleagues, including resource schedules, budgets, financial forecasts, progress logs, etc. Owns creation, development, and maintenance of organizational/strategic artifacts.

  • Manages and resolves conflicts and disagreements in a constructive manner. Solves escalated issues and directly contributes to problem resolution. Monitors the success of conflict management measures and remains alert to any ongoing problems.

Gestionnaire principal(e) de programme

Rémunération

100 000 $ à 150 000 $ CA

Sommaire du poste

Diriger stratégiquement les programmes approuvés tout au long du cycle de vie des projets, en s’appuyant sur son expertise pour anticiper et gérer les demandes de changements, la gestion des enjeux, la gestion des risques et les rapports d’état. Déléguer les tâches aux membres de l’équipe les mieux placés pour les exécuter. Être responsable de la prise de décisions efficaces lorsque plusieurs options de progression du projet sont présentées. Met en place des processus de gouvernance budgétaire au niveau du programme afin d’assurer l’efficacité et la réalisation des initiatives dans les délais.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Telesales Operations Associate to join our Retention Team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


About M-KOPA

M-KOPA has connected 10 million customers to life-changing technology and services, unlocking $2B+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa. With 35,000+ field agents and 2,300+ employees, we've built one of Africa's largest asset financing platforms, one where 86% of customers report improved quality of life and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time. We call them Every Day Earners, and everything we build exists to expand what's possible for them.

Role overview

As Telesales Operations Associate, you'll provide the operational backbone for our Telesales Team in Nigeria, a hybrid role based in our office and working alongside colleagues across the UK, Europe, and Africa. You'll report to the Telesales Team Lead and be the connective tissue between sales agents, shop teams, and delivery partners, making sure every sale that gets closed actually gets fulfilled.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our office in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Telesales Team Lead.


What makes this different

This isn't back-office admin for its own sake. Every account you create, every delivery you unblock, every stock shortage you catch early is a customer who gets their product on time instead of falling out of the funnel. You'll have direct visibility into where the sales process breaks and real ownership over fixing it.

What You'll Do

  • Supporting telesales agents through account creation, device unlocking, and closing out compliance and documentation before handover

  • Coordinating delivery requests with DSRs and shop teams, chasing down delayed or failed deliveries until resolved

  • Monitoring stock levels across shops and escalating shortages before they disrupt sales

  • Keeping CRM and internal systems updated with accurate fulfilment and delivery status

  • Any other tasks as assigned by the Telesales Team Leader.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, or a related field

  • 3 – 5 years' experience in telesales operations, sales administration, customer service, or operations support (an added advantage)

  • Strong CRM experience (FreshDesk, 3CX, or similar), sharp organisational instincts, and comfort working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

The honest part

Sales moves fast, and things go wrong: deliveries stall, stock runs short, documentation gets missed. You'll be the person tracking it all down and getting it sorted, often under time pressure. If chasing loose ends to closure sounds satisfying rather than draining, you'll fit right in.

Ready to help us get the small moments right, at scale? Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

  • clarity, readability, and organization;
  • precision and consistency of language;
  • preservation of technical meaning;
  • usability and accessibility for intended audiences; and
  • overall editorial quality.

If the volume or complexity of the assigned materials exceeds what can reasonably be completed within 25 hours, the contractor will notify the project lead, identify outstanding work, and recommend priorities before proceeding.

Scope of Work

Within the agreed-upon level of effort, the contractor will:

  • Review prioritized materials to identify significant issues related to organization, flow, readability, terminology, precision, consistency, and accessibility.
  • Substantively and developmentally edit assigned content to improve organization, sequencing, clarity, transitions, directions, explanations, and relationships among concepts, evidence, criteria, and guidance.
  • Edit for clarity and precision by reducing ambiguity, unnecessary complexity, repetition, and wordiness while preserving the nuance and intended meaning of the content.
  • Preserve technical fidelity by reviewing proposed edits to ensure they do not unintentionally change mathematical concepts, multilingual learner considerations, evidence statements, criteria, scoring guidance, or intended interpretations.
  • Identify and document substantive questions requiring review by EdReports content or subject-matter experts rather than independently resolving questions outside the contractor's editorial expertise.
  • Strengthen consistency across prioritized materials, including terminology, definitions, directions, examples, language conventions, and related explanations.
  • Copyedit and conduct quality control for grammar, syntax, punctuation, spelling, mechanics, usage, and editorial consistency.
  • Incorporate one consolidated round of EdReports feedback and conduct a final editorial review of the agreed-upon materials, as time permits within the 25-hour engagement.

Compensation & Contract Period

This contract is expected to require up to 25 hours of work and will be compensated at $100 per hour, for a maximum contract amount of $2,500. The contractor may not exceed 25 hours without prior written approval from EdReports. The contract period is approximately October 2026 through November 2026.

Deliverables

Within the 25-hour engagement, the contractor will provide:

  1. Edited Priority MaterialsSubstantive, developmental, and copy edits to the materials identified as priorities at the start of the engagement.

  3. Editorial Style/Decision LogA concise record of recurring terminology, usage, capitalization, formatting, and other editorial decisions identified through the work.
  4. Final Revised MaterialsIncorporation of one consolidated round of feedback and a final editorial quality-control review of agreed-upon materials within the available contract hours.

Successful Completion

The engagement will be considered successfully completed when the contractor has:

  • completed the agreed-upon priority work within the 25-hour level of effort;
  • improved the clarity, organization, precision, readability, and consistency of the materials addressed;
  • preserved the technical meaning and intent of the underlying content;
  • appropriately identified issues requiring subject-matter expert decisions;
  • consistently applied agreed-upon editorial decisions; and
  • provided EdReports with edited materials and documentation sufficient to support any remaining or future revisions.

Completion of the engagement is based on the agreed-upon level of effort and prioritized deliverables, rather than completion of an unlimited volume of MLL Early Math materials.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own and push the limits of model inference performance at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production—turning cutting-edge models into fast, reliable, and cost-efficient systems that serve real users.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys deep technical work, profiling systems down to the kernel/GPU level, and translating research ideas into production-grade performance gains.

What You’ll Do

  • Optimize inference latency, throughput, and cost for large-scale ML models in production

  • Profile and bottleneck GPU/CPU inference pipelines (memory, kernels, batching, IO)

  • Implement and tune techniques such as:

    • Quantization (fp16, bf16, int8, fp8)

    • KV-cache optimization & reuse

    • Speculative decoding, batching, and streaming

    • Model pruning or architectural simplifications for inference

  • Collaborate with research engineers to productionize new model architectures

  • Build and maintain inference-serving systems (e.g. Triton, custom runtimes, or bespoke stacks)

  • Benchmark performance across hardware (NVIDIA / AMD GPUs, CPUs) and cloud setups

  • Improve system reliability, observability, and cost efficiency under real workloads

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in ML inference optimization or high-performance ML systems

  • Solid understanding of deep learning internals (attention, memory layout, compute graphs)

  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch (or similar) and model deployment

  • Familiarity with GPU performance tuning (CUDA, ROCm, Triton, or kernel-level optimizations)

  • Experience scaling inference for real users (not just research benchmarks)

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments with ownership and ambiguity

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLM or long-context model inference

  • Knowledge of inference frameworks (TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, vLLM, Triton)

  • Experience optimizing across different hardware vendors

  • Open-source contributions in ML systems or inference tooling

  • Background in distributed systems or low-latency services

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership over performance-critical systems

  • Direct impact on product reliability and unit economics

  • Close collaboration with research, infra, and product

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity at Series A

  • A team that cares about engineering quality, not hype

We are looking for a Telesales Quality Assurance & Training Analyst to join our Retention Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

Role Overview

As Telesales QA & Training Analyst, you'll sit at the point where sales performance meets customer protection, listening to real conversations, spotting where agents need support, and helping build the training that closes those gaps.

About M-KOPA

M-KOPA has grown to 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa, extending over $2 billion in credit to people building better lives one asset at a time. 86% of our customers report improved satisfaction, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time through us. Behind that scale sits a network of over 35,000 field agents and 2,300+ employees, all working toward one goal: helping Every Day Earners own more, faster.

This is an hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa.

What makes this different

This isn't a quality-checklist job. Every evaluation you run and every coaching session you support feeds directly into whether an agent explains a payment plan correctly, whether a customer understands what they're signing up for, and whether M-KOPA keeps the trust that got us to 10 million customers. Your findings shape real training content, not just a compliance report nobody reads.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct quality evaluations of Telesales inbound, outbound, and non-voice interactions, assessing adherence to sales processes, compliance requirements, and customer communication standards.

  • Analyze customer interactions to identify recurring objections, sales barriers, and performance gaps, and prepare quality and training reports for the QA & Training Lead.

  • Support the design and delivery of onboarding and refresher training, developing call guides and learning materials to close identified skill gaps.

  • Deliver structured coaching and feedback to agents based on QA findings, and support the QA & Training Lead in monitoring resulting action plans.

  • Any other tasks as assigned by the hiring manager.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, communications, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Training, Coaching, Telesales, or Contact Centre Operations.

  • Proven experience in call quality monitoring and performance analysis, with proficiency in CRM systems and data-informed decision-making.

The honest part

This role means spending real time in the detail: listening back through calls, spotting patterns others miss, and having direct, sometimes difficult feedback conversations with agents. If you'd rather sit above the data than in it, this isn't the seat for you.

Ready to help us get the small moments right, at scale? Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the US.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Analyst
Full-time, Remote

Check out The Global Talent Co.’s talent network:

About Us:
At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25k+ like-minded marketing professionals.

The company you will work with is a fast-growing, data-driven organization focused on optimizing product performance and marketing effectiveness through advanced analytics. They specialize in e-commerce and subscription-based business models, leveraging cutting-edge data science tools to drive strategic decision-making. With a commitment to innovation and continuous improvement, the company empowers teams with actionable insights to accelerate growth and enhance customer engagement.

The Role

As a Senior Product/Marketing Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed decisions that directly impact product growth and marketing ROI. You will analyze complex datasets, design and interpret experiments, and collaborate closely with product and marketing teams to optimize business performance.

This role is ideal for a data-driven storyteller who combines strong technical skills with commercial insight and experimentation experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze product usage, user behavior, and marketing campaign performance with a focus on business impact, growth, and revenue optimization.

  • Collaborate with product managers and marketers to define commercial metrics, design and execute A/B or multivariate experiments, and translate results into actionable business strategies.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track KPIs and provide insights that inform decision-making at the strategic level.

  • Build and deploy data pipelines and models to automate reporting and analysis processes.

  • Proactively identify and investigate data anomalies or trends affecting product and marketing outcomes.

  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders, translating complex data into business recommendations.

  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of data infrastructure and analytical tools in collaboration with the product analytics team.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science); Master’s preferred.

  • 7+ years of experience in product and/or marketing analytics with measurable business impact.

  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts (hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis).

  • Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets.

  • Experience in designing, executing, and interpreting experiments (A/B, multivariate) in product or marketing contexts.

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and commercial acumen skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to translate complex data insights for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with e-commerce businesses; experience with subscription-based models is a plus.

  • Technical proficiency with:

    • Python (Anaconda, Poetry/Pipenv or piplock)

    • Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions

    • Infrastructure: AWS (S3, ECR, EKS)

    • Reporting & Visualization: Tableau, Streamlit

    • Workflow Orchestration: Prefect or Airflow

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with MLflow, SpiceRack, Databricks

  • Familiarity with hyperparameter optimization (Ax, Optuna)

  • Experience contributing to data infrastructure and advanced analytics tools

This is your opportunity to make a tangible impact within a rapidly growing company dedicated to transforming the future of work. Join a team that values creativity, initiative, and results!

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they are born in.

jobs.title: Account Manager - German speaking (m/f/d)
jobs.excerpt: Das UnternehmenGerade für kleine Unternehmen muss es oft schnell gehen.
jobs.description:
Das Unternehmen

Gerade für kleine Unternehmen muss es oft schnell gehen. Chancen warten nicht und Liquiditätsengpässe können über Nacht entstehen. Um voranzukommen und zu wachsen, brauchen KMU Finanzierung, die genauso flexibel und reaktionsschnell ist wie sie selbst.

Genau deshalb haben wir iwoca gegründet. Unsere smarte Technologie, moderne Datenanalyse und unser erstklassiger Kundenservice sorgen dafür, dass Unternehmer*innen schnell, sicher und kontrolliert handeln können - genau in den Momenten, in denen es darauf ankommt.

Wir haben bereits mehr als 150.000 Unternehmen mit über 4,5 Milliarden Euro unterstützt. Unser Team setzt alles daran, noch mehr Mittelständler*innen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen - durch besseren Zugang zu Finanzierung und zusätzliche Services, die den Geschäftsalltag einfacher machen. Unsere Mission? Eine Million Unternehmen in ihren entscheidenden Momenten zu unterstützen und so einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zu leisten- sowohl für die Unternehmen selbst, als auch für ihr wirtschaftliches Ökosystem und die deutsche Gesamtwirtschaft.

Die Stelle

Als Account Manager*in bist du die direkte Schnittschnelle zu unseren Kund*innen und die Stimme von iwoca. Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio von Neu- und Bestandskund*innen und unterstützt eigenverantwortlich Unternehmer*innen während unseres Kreditprozesses und der gesamten Kreditlaufzeit. Dabei legst du höchsten Wert auf Kundenservice und ermöglichst unseren Kund*innen durch deine Kommunikation die optimale Nutzung unserer Produkte.
Ein grundlegender Baustein für unseren Erfolg ist es, Kund*innen und Partner*innen von unserer Mission zu überzeugen und zu begeistern - das reicht bei unseren Kund*innen vom Frisörsalon bis zur Zahnarztpraxis und bei unseren Partner*innen von der Finanzberatung bis zu den Mitarbeiter*innen der Bankfiliale.

Wenn Sie mehr über diese Position erfahren möchten, finden Sie hier den passenden Artikel.

Zusammen arbeiten, gemeinsam wachsen: Bei uns erwartet dich ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Dass unsere Kultur nicht nur auf dem Papier gut klingt, zeigt auch unser Kununu-Score von über 4,4 – ein Team, auf das man sich jeden Tag freuen kann!

Die Anforderungen

Grundlegend:

  • Zeigt Neugier im Umgang mit KI-Tools und Interesse daran, diese weiter zu erlernen. Du nutzt KI bereits sicher in der Praxis, um Probleme zu lösen, effizienter zu arbeiten und die Qualität deiner Arbeit zu verbessern. Dabei zeigst du ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann der Einsatz sinnvoll ist, und kannst deine Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar begründen.

  • Du begleitest Neukund*innen bei den Schritten für einen erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss und übertriffst ihre Erwartungen, indem du auf individuelle Anliegen eingehst und zusammen mit Kund*innen den optimalen Einsatz für unser Produkt findest.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Kund*innen über ihre individuellen Möglichkeiten und unsere Produktentwicklungen rasch informiert sind.

  • Du verantwortest dein eigenes Portfolio an bestehenden und neuen Kund*innen.

  • Du baust starke, langfristige Beziehungen zu deinen Kund*innen auf und hilfst ihnen dabei, ihre Geschäftsziele mit iwoca zu erreichen.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis der Funktionsweise von Unternehmen, einschließlich ihrer wichtigsten Risiko- und Ertragsfaktoren.

  • Durch dein regelmäßiges Feedback zu Rückmeldungen unserer Kund*innen, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten unserer Prozesse oder neue Angebote unserer Wettbewerber nimmst du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von iwoca teil.

Das Wichtigste zu Dir:

Wir suchen Menschen, die smart, bodenständig und motiviert sind und sich ständig weiterentwickeln wollen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, trifft im Idealfall Folgendes auf Dich zu:

  • Du hast Spaß an der Kommunikation mit Kund*innen und lebst “Customer Centricity". Für dich ist es die größte Motivation, Erfolge mit unseren Kund*innen zu erzielen.

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium und kannst mit relevanter Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice punkten (Erfahrungen im Bankenumfeld oder einem Fintech sind ein Plus).

  • Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und kannst das Team bei bereichsübergreifenden Projekten unterstützen.

  • Du bist hochmotiviert, organisiert, vertriebsorientiert und hast eine ‘Hands-on-Mentalität’.

  • Du hast exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse(C1/C2). Außerdem bringst du Englischkenntnisse mit, sodass Meetings in unserem internationalen Team kein Problem für dich sind.

  • Eine selbstständige, teamorientierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise ist für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, "über den Tellerrand hinauszudenken", um Optimierungsvorschläge zu unseren Produkten, Systemen und Prozessen zu machen.

Das Gehalt

Wir rechnen mit einem Gehalt zwischen 41.000 € und 50.000 € für diese Stelle. Uns ist es jedoch wichtig, dich fair zu bezahlen, also gib in deiner Bewerbung unbedingt deine Gehaltsvorstellungen an. Wir vergleichen Gehälter regelmäßig mit den marktüblichen Sätzen und führen zusätzlich vierteljährliche Performance- und Gehaltsreviews durch.

Die Kultur

Bei iwoca gewinnt die beste Idee. Unsere Kultur basiert auf eigenständigem Denken, dem Hinterfragen von Annahmen und faktenbasierten Entscheidungen. Wir legen großen Wert auf Lernen und Weiterentwicklung und geben dir die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, in der du am wirkungsvollsten bist.

Wir sind ein Technologieunternehmen und glauben an das Potenzial von KI, uns schneller und besser arbeiten zu lassen. Wir schaffen die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass alle im Team jederzeit Zugriff auf die besten Modelle haben – und dass diese Modelle mit unseren Daten arbeiten können. Gleichzeitig unterstützen wir dich dabei, den Umgang mit neuen Tools zu lernen und dich mit ihnen weiterzuentwickeln.

Die Büros

Wir geben uns viel Mühe, iwoca zu einem großartigen Arbeitsplatz zu machen:

  • Büros in Berlin, Frankfurt, London und Leeds mit reichlich Snacks und Getränken

  • Veranstaltungen und Clubs: Von Laufgruppen und Padel bis hin zu monatlichen Ping-Pong- und Billard-Turnieren

Die Benefits

  • Ein smartes, motiviertes und internationales Team (wir vertreten über 35 verschiedene Nationalitäten) mit einem unbändigen Growth-Mindset

  • 26 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus ein freier Tag an deinem Geburtstag, die Möglichkeit, bis zu fünf Urlaubstage zu kaufen oder zu verkaufen, sowie unbegrenzter (unbezahlter) Urlaub

  • Ein 1-monatiges, voll bezahltes Sabbatical nach 4 Jahren bei iwoca

  • Direkter Zugang zur Unterstützung von zertifizierten Psycholog*innen mit unserem Partner OpenUp für Teammitglieder, die emotionale oder mentale Unterstützung brauchen

  • Zuschuss zur Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft: 25 € für Fit711 oder den Urban Sports Club

  • 30 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über Canada Life

  • Top-Standorte: In Frankfurt direkt in der Innenstadt, in Berlin mitten im Prenzlauer Berg

  • Ein bezahlter Tag für Freiwilligenarbeit, an dem du eine gemeinnützige Organisation deiner Wahl unterstützen kannst

  • Voll ausgestattete Kühlschränke in unseren Büros mit allem, was das Herz begehrt: von gesunden Snacks bis hin zu Nervennahrung für den ganzen Tag

  • “Summer Houses” im Süden Europas und “Winter Houses” in den Alpen – bisher ging’s unter anderem nach Frankreich, Italien, Spanien und sogar noch weiter weg

  • Corporate Benefits Rabatte

Und damit das Lernen nie aufhört, bieten wir:

  • Ein persönliches Budget zum Lernen und Weiterbilden für alle

  • Ein Budget für Deutsch/Englisch-Unterricht

  • Vorträge mit internen und externen Referent*innen für das ganze Unternehmen

  • Zugang zu Lernplattformen wie Treehouse

Nützliche Links:

  • Mehr Details und zusätzliche Benefits findest du unter iwoca Benefits & Richtlinien

  • Hier findest du unser iwoca Willkommenspaket für Interviews

Compensation Range: €41K - €50K

Über Corominas Consulting:

Wir bei Corominas Consulting haben eine klare Mission: Wir sind die Experten für das Marketing von Anwalts- und Steuerkanzleien. Unsere Vision ist es, die unangefochtene Nummer eins im deutschsprachigen Raum zu werden. Wir helfen Kanzleien dabei, sich voll auf ihre Mandanten zu konzentrieren, während wir ihr Marketing und ihre digitalen Prozesse auf das nächste Level heben.

Wenn du Lust hast, mit uns gemeinsam eine ganze Branche zu modernisieren – dann lies weiter.

Wir leben Effizienz, modernste Software-Workflows und messbare Ergebnisse. Zur Verstärkung unseres eigenen Wachstums suchen wir einen ambitionierten Sales Setter (m/w/d), der den Grundstein für seine Karriere im High-Ticket-Vertrieb legen möchte.

Diese Position ist deine gezielte Vorstufe zur Rolle als Closer. Wir stellen Closer nicht extern ein, sondern bilden unser Top-Personal ausschließlich intern aus.

Aufgaben

Deine Kernaufgaben:

  • Qualifizierung von Inbound-Leads: Du bist unser strategischer Filter. Du prüfst neue Anfragen via Google Meet oder Nachricht und entscheidest, ob die Interessenten perfekt zu unseren Lösungen passen.
  • Strategisches Terminmanagement: Du führst die Erstgespräche und buchst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Sales-Experten.
  • Follow-up & Reaktivierung: Du bleibst an Bestands-Kontakten dran und fasst konsequent bei Leads nach, um keine Potenziale liegenzulassen.
  • CRM-Pflege & Dokumentation: Du arbeitest in einer sauberen digitalen Struktur (Airtable/CRM), damit das Team jederzeit weiß, wo ein Projekt steht.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und liebst es, Menschen in Video-Calls zu überzeugen.
  • Du denkst ergebnisorientiert und hast den nötigen Biss im Follow-up.
  • Du arbeitest hochgradig strukturiert und schätzt klare To-do-Systeme.
  • Du hast Lust auf eine steile Lernkurve und willst Verantwortung übernehmen.

Benefits

Was dich bei Corominas Consulting erwartet:

  • 100 % Remote-Infrastruktur: Arbeite von wo du willst – wir nutzen Google Meet und die besten digitalen Tools am Markt.
  • Attraktive variable Vergütung: Neben deinem Fixum profitierst du von einem transparenten Provisionsmodell. Dein Erfolg zahlt sich direkt aus – nach oben gibt es keine Deckelung.

Wir bauen gerade etwas auf, das es in dieser Form im deutschsprachigen Raum noch nicht gibt – und wir suchen Leute, die diese Reise mit uns gehen wollen. Wenn du dich hier wiedererkennst und Bock hast, mit uns die Kanzleiwelt zu verändern, dann melde dich.

Deine Bewerbung: Wir brauchen keine langen Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu deiner Motivation.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Manager
jobs.excerpt: Welcome to a workplace where everyone passionately believes in one purpose!
jobs.description:
Welcome to a workplace where everyone passionately believes in one purpose!

Our company's commitment extends beyond tasks; it's about infusing every action with purpose. We are dedicated to bringing unparalleled passion and customer focus to every facet of our business, creating an environment where your contribution truly matters.

With 70 years of experience, we are the leading strategic partner, providing specialized solutions for airlines, airports, and enterprises across 21 countries throughout The Caribbean and Latin America.

At GCG, we believe the secret recipe for a perfect team blends talent, focus, and discipline. We seek these qualities in candidates eager to thrive in a diverse and multicultural environment.

Our comprehensive solutions include Sky Dining, Airport Dining, Aviation Support, and Culinary. With a team of over 5,500 highly skilled experts dedicated to excellence, we uphold the highest standards of quality and service. We are committed to elevating travel & culinary experiences for all our customer's journeys, becoming the top choice in the region.

JOB PURPOSE

Lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of the Group’s technology infrastructure across all stations in Latin America & the Caribbean. The role ensures a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient infrastructure that enables business growth and operational excellence. This leader owns infrastructure roadmaps (network, compute, storage, cloud, collaboration, endpoint, connectivity), orchestrates a multi-country delivery model with cluster and station IT teams, and drives program/portfolio management for all infrastructure initiatives.

This role co-owns the Cybersecurity Program (policies, controls, remediation, awareness, DR/BCP) in partnership with the Cybersecurity Manager, ensuring implementation, compliance, remediation, and operationalization of controls across the Group.



Duties & Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic leadership & execution

  • Build and execute a 24-month rolling Infrastructure Strategy & Roadmap aligned to business priorities, budgets, and Project Atlas (SAP S/4HANA) timelines; translate strategy into funded programs with clear milestones and KPIs.
  • Establish a portfolio management cadence: intake, prioritization, capacity planning, delivery tracking, realization; chair monthly Infra Portfolio Reviews with stakeholders.
  • Own the infrastructure operating model (Group/Cluster/Station): RACI, standards, service definitions, SLAs, and escalation paths.
  • Drive cost optimization (licenses, links, datacenter footprint, cloud consumption) while protecting availability, performance, and security.

Program & project management

  • Act as overall program owner for infrastructure initiatives (e.g., network refresh, WAN/SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, datacenter/server virtualization, M365/endpoint modernization, backup/DR, cloud migrations, connectivity/Starlink or backup links).
  • Institutionalize PMO discipline: business cases, charters, RAID logs, change control, stage gates, stakeholder comms, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Standardize project artifacts and ensure every project has scope, timeline, budget, resourcing plan, risks/mitigations, and measurable outcomes.

Operations & service reliability

  • Ensure high availability and performance for network, servers, storage, voice/data, collaboration, and site connectivity across all stations; own incident, problem, capacity, and change management practices.
  • Define and monitor SLA targets (uptime, MTTR, change success rate, backup success, patch compliance) and publish monthly scorecards.
  • Maintain DR/BCP readiness through tested recovery runbooks, defined RPO/RTO targets and periodic end-to-end exercises aligned with business criticality; own and drive infrastructure resilience and DR remediation plans resulting from audits, incidents and risk assessments.

Cybersecurity program (co-ownership with Cybersecurity Manager)

  • Execute the cybersecurity roadmap: hardening baselines, identity & access, endpoint protection/EDR, patching, vulnerability management, email security, logging/SIEM, and awareness.
  • Ensure stations implement required controls; track closure of findings, and report on cybersecurity KPIs and risk posture to SteerCo/EC.
  • Maintain secure configurations for firewalls, remote access, and network segmentation; enforce least privilege and separation of duties.

Architecture, standards & compliance

  • Own the Group identity, endpoint management and device governance framework, ensuring centralized management, appropriate administrative privileges, patching, configuration standards and security controls across corporate endpoints.
  • Own Group infrastructure standards (network, server, storage, cloud, endpoint, backup, monitoring) and lifecycle plans (EOL/EOS refresh).
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, vendor licensing, data protection, and applicable regulatory requirements across countries.

Vendor & budget management

  • Lead sourcing and performance management for ISPs, telco, hardware, software, MSPs, and OEMs; negotiate contracts and SLAs.
  • Own the infrastructure budget (OPEX/CAPEX), forecasts, and variance reporting; pursue TCO reduction through consolidation and right-sizing.

People leadership

  • Lead and develop Cluster IT Managers, IT Coordinators, and Field Support; build succession pipelines, coach performance, and foster a high-accountability culture.
  • Elevate managerial rigor: objectives/KPIs, 1:1s, quarterly talent reviews, and recognition for delivery excellence.

Qualifications & Skills


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; master’s degree is a plus.
  • Bilingual: English and Spanish (mandatory).
  • Formal project management training required (e.g., PMP/Prince2, or equivalent). ITIL v4 Foundation preferred. Cloud/network/security certifications are a plus (e.g., CCNP, Azure/AWS associate, Fortinet/Palo Alto).

Experience

  • 12+ years progressive IT experience, ideally within multi-country operations in aviation, travel services, or food & beverage manufacturing/retail.
  • 8+ years leading complex infrastructure programs/projects (business cases, budgets, risk/issue management, scope/change control, benefits).
  • Proven success managing distributed teams and vendors across multiple countries and cultures, delivering to SLAs and budgets.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Agility & Execution: Converts strategy into an actionable portfolio with clear KPIs; consistently ships on time and on budget.
  • Program/Project Leadership: Establishes governance, stage gates, RAID discipline, and stakeholder comms; unblocks delivery.
  • Service Reliability Mindset: Designs for availability, resilience, and observability; data-driven on SLAs and incident metrics.
  • Cybersecurity-by-Design: Implements controls and remediation in partnership with Cybersecurity; enforces standards and patch hygiene.
  • Vendor & Cost Management: Negotiates SLAs, optimizes TCO, and manages multi-vendor ecosystems effectively.
  • Influence & Communication (EN/ES): Fluent in English and Spanish; able to influence executives and align station managers to Group standards.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Structures complex issues, uses data to decide, and drives root-cause corrective actions.
  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes end-to-end ownership for commitments and outcomes; proactively identifies roadblocks, escalates when required, and drives issues to resolution without transferring accountability to vendors, peers or other functions.

Travel requirements

The position requires regular domestic and international travel across GCG locations in Latin America and the Caribbean, based on project, operational, audit and business requirements.

Embark on a journey with us, where every day brings new opportunities for growth and success. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and want to be part of a team that celebrates achievements, come, be a part of our story. Your career adventure starts here!

Job Title:

Growth Marketing Manager

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Position Summary

As a Growth Marketing Manager on our B2B Marketing & Sales team, you’ll own the execution and optimization of integrated demand generation programs across organic, inbound, paid, and email channels. This remote role, based in the United States or Canada, is ideal for a data-driven marketer who understands the technical layer behind modern B2B growth — from SEO, AEO, GEO, and CRO to marketing automation, website performance, analytics, and AI-enabled execution.

You’ll report to the Director of Marketing Strategy, B2B, and work closely with performance analysts, content specialists, sales partners, GTM teams, digital advertising teams, and client-facing program leads to turn campaign strategy into measurable pipeline impact.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

  • Plan and execute integrated demand generation programs across organic, inbound, paid, and email channels with clear pipeline objectives and KPIs at each funnel stage.
  • Develop go-to-market campaign programs, including audience segmentation, messaging frameworks, asset briefs, launch sequencing, and performance tracking.
  • Coordinate with digital advertising teams on paid social and search campaign strategy and briefing, bringing audience insight, messaging direction, and optimization recommendations.
  • Partner with sales and GTM teams on campaign launches by delivering briefing materials, demand signals, campaign updates, and performance insights they can act on.

Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

Reporting to the Managing Director of Social Commerce, this is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who lives at the intersection of creative and performance - building influencer relationships, shaping the content that goes to market, and using data to make it work harder.

You’ll own the relationships with creators and influencers who bring our clients’ brands to life, and you’ll translate performance signals into sharper hooks, briefs, and content direction. This is a hands-on role: less about running a team, more about being the person who knows what content is working, why, and what to make next.

You’ll partner closely with the Directors of Strategy, Media Buying, and Creative to ensure content and influencer output is aligned with brand goals, platform best practices, and campaign performance targets.

  • Strong content instincts paired with a performance mindset — you can write a hook, read the data behind it, and know what to change.

Diese Position erfordert eine ausgeprägte strategische Denkweise, tiefes Kunden- und Marktverständnis sowie die kommerzielle Disziplin, das Portfolio durch die Einführung neuer Produkte, exzellente Go-to-Market-Strategien und die Expansion in angrenzende Anwendungen zu skalieren. Sie managen den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und sind direkt verantwortlich für Umsatzwachstum, Margensteigerung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Portfolios und operative Leistung.

Sie überzeugen durch Einflussnahme, indem Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams mobilisieren, globale Abstimmung schaffen und Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten und Kunden-Insights vorantreiben. Dies ist eine hochsichtbare, wirkungsvolle Rolle im Zentrum der strategischen Agenda von TE Industrial.

Stellenanforderungen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer umfassenden globalen Portfoliostrategie zur nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Margensteigerung in Schlüsselmärkten
  • Identifizierung von Durchbruchmöglichkeiten (neue Anwendungen, Plattformen, Technologien, Geschäftsmodelle und gezielte M&A-Chancen), die die Wettbewerbsposition von TE stärken
  • Übersetzung von Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnissen, Technologieveränderungen, regulatorischen Änderungen und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten in klare strategische Maßnahmen
  • Aufbau und Pflege von Produkt- und Technologie-Roadmaps in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Sales und Operations, um TE in bestehenden und neuen Segmenten erfolgreich zu positionieren
  • Leitung von VOC- und Anwendungs-Insight-Programmen zur Entwicklung differenzierter Produktvorschläge und zur Steuerung von Investitionsentscheidungen
  • Unterstützung strategischer Partnerschaften und M&A-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Zielanalyse, strategischer Begründung, Markt-/Portfolio-Fit-Bewertungen sowie Post-Merger-Integration mit Fokus auf Portfolioharmonisierung, Produktlinienkonsolidierung und Roadmap-Ausrichtung
  • Definition von Ressourcenanforderungen und Führung der globalen Preisstrategie, einschließlich wertbasierter Preisgestaltung, Rabatt-Governance und Margenoptimierung, bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung konsistenter Umsetzung, kommerzieller Bereitschaft und lokaler Marktreaktionsfähigkeit
  • Übernahme der vollständigen P&L-Verantwortung für globale Produktlinien, Erzielung von überdurchschnittlichem Wachstum durch NPI-Adoption, Kundendesign-Gewinne und Marktanteilssteigerungen in Zielsegmenten
  • Überwachung der Performance im Vergleich zum Jahres- und Langfristplan, Risikomanagement und Schaffung von Wettbewerbsvorteilen durch Produktdifferenzierung, operative Effizienz und strategisches Kostenmanagement

Was Sie mitbringen sollten:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaft; MBA oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in P&L-Verantwortung bevorzugt
  • 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Strategie, Business Development oder vergleichbaren Bereichen innerhalb der industriellen Technologie oder angrenzender Märkte
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in Portfoliostrategie, Lifecycle-Management, Roadmap-Erstellung und Identifizierung von Produktlücken
  • Erfolgsbilanz bei Umsatzwachstum, Kostenoptimierung und Margenverbesserung
  • Erfahrung in industriellen Märkten bevorzugt (Geräte, Steckverbinder, elektromechanische Komponenten, industrielle Automatisierung etc.)
  • Ausgeprägte finanzielle und quantitative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Insights abzuleiten und disziplinierte Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Reisebereitschaft bis zu 25% weltweit
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse erforderlich

Kompetenzen

Werte: Integrität, Verantwortlichkeit, Inklusion, Innovation, Teamarbeit

ÜBER TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) ist ein weltweit führendes Industrie- und Technologieunternehmen, das eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft ermöglicht. Als verlässlicher Innovationspartner entwickelt TE Konnektivitäts- und Sensorlösungen, die die Verteilung und Übertragung von Strom, Signalen und Daten unterstützen und Innovationen in den Bereichen Transport der nächsten Generation, Stromnetze, industrielle Automatisierung, KI-Rechenzentren und vieles mehr vorantreiben. Mit mehr als 90.000 Mitarbeitenden, darunter 10.000 Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure, arbeitet TE Seite an Seite mit Kundinnen und Kunden in rund 130 Ländern zusammen. In einer Welt, die sich rasant weiterentwickelt, bleibt TE seinem Leitsatz treu: EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Erfahren Sie mehr auf und auf LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram und X (ehemals Twitter).
