About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

About the Role

Accelerant Captive Solutions (ACS) is a specialty underwriting platform focused on complex middle market risks. We write business across three structures — Captive, Loss Sensitive, and Fronting — and are looking for an experienced senior underwriter to help grow our loss sensitive and captive book.

This is a senior underwriting role. The right candidate brings technical depth in loss sensitive structures, established broker relationships, and a track record of underwriting middle market commercial risks profitably.

What You’ll Do

  • Underwrite loss sensitive middle market and national account risks, including large deductible, SIR, and retrospective rating programs, with sound technical judgment on pricing, structure, and terms.
  • Build and maintain broker relationships, serving as a consistent and reliable market for complex, loss-sensitive placements and captive structures in the middle market.
  • Deliver multi-option solutions on eligible submissions — captive and loss sensitive — ensuring brokers have a complete picture of available structures for each account.
  • Manage and grow an assigned book of business, maintaining underwriting discipline, monitoring portfolio quality, and achieving production targets.
  • Build admitted and non-admitted insurance products including building a forms library and assisting in the implementation of a policy administration system.

Who You Are

Background: 5–12+ years of commercial lines underwriting experience at a top carrier, with a focus on middle market or national accounts. Hands-on technical expertise in loss sensitive structures — large deductible, SIR, and retrospective rating — is required. Captive experience is a plus.

Approach: You are commercially minded and results-oriented — you know how to win business and build broker trust over time. You are rigorous on the technical side, confident pricing complex structures, and focused on building a profitable, growing book.

Por qué LAYERS

  • Una misión que importa: ayudar a que la agricultura crezca de forma sostenible y rentable
  • Una empresa SaaS en rápido crecimiento, con un producto único ya confiado por grandes actores en America Latina

jobs.excerpt: Why should you join Jerry? • Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).
jobs.description:
Why should you join Jerry?

  • Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).

  • Work closely with brilliant leaders and teammates from companies like McKinsey, BCG, Nvidia, Better, SoFi, etc.

  • Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.

  • Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.

  • Own end-to-end creative excellence and be a tastemaker at Jerry - from concepting and production to agency management.

About the role

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners' needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we're just getting started.

We're looking for a Senior Creative Strategist with sharp performance instincts and elevated visual taste. Someone who’s obsessed with advertising, and excited about how AI and new media are reshaping creative production. You'll own the full creative lifecycle: concepting, producing, and iterating ads that drive measurable results across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and CTV, while raising the bar on craft and brand quality. You will be a driving force of Jerry’s creative engine with production chops to bring ideas to life yourself.

Why you will (or won’t) like working here

  • Large canvas: You won’t inherit a set-in-stone playbook. You will contribute meaningfully for our brand foundation. Your creative intuition will direct us to both what performs and what builds brand equity.

  • End-to-end ownership: This is a senior level role in scope and impact, but you also will be hands-on: concepting, directing production briefs, writing scripts, editing video, and using AI tools to move fast and unlock the next level.

  • Car ownership is not “sexy”: Insurance, maintenance, and safety are only topics people think about when they have a bill to pay, a flat tire to change, or when they get into an accident. Anyone can market something inherently exciting, but can you build enthusiasm and trust around a “dry” topic?

What you'll do

  • Concept and produce performance creative end-to-end: from ideation and scripting through editing and delivery, across paid social, CTV, and emerging channels.

  • Bring a sharp creative eye to every asset: elevating visual quality, pacing, and storytelling to raise Jerry's brand while keeping creative performance-driven.

  • Stay on top of platform trends, formats, and cultural shifts: ensuring Jerry's creative stays fresh, relevant, and effective.

  • Develop hooks, angles, and creative frameworks rooted in what actually drives performance, not just what looks good.

  • Translate performance data into creative direction: partnering with media and growth teams to turn signals into better ads.

  • Manage and maximize agency and production partners: writing briefs, providing creative direction, and quality-checking work to ensure external teams deliver at Jerry's standard.

  • Edit video directly: you're fluent in editing tools and comfortable cutting, iterating, and polishing ads at speed without sacrificing quality.

  • Leverage AI tools (for ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, etc.) to accelerate workflows and unlock new creative possibilities.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in performance-driven creative production — ideally at a performance media agency and/or an in-house growth creative team at a DTC or app-based company.

  • Proven track record producing or directing high-performing creative for paid channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, etc.).

  • Strong performance creative intuition — you understand hooks, pacing, CTAs, and what makes people stop scrolling. You can concept ads that convert

  • Elevated visual taste — you have an eye for design, composition, and brand quality. You can take performance creative from functional to beautiful without losing effectiveness.

  • Video editing fluency — you can cut and iterate ads quickly yourself, making them look premium without needing heavy direction.

  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial mindset — thrives in fast-paced environments, comfortable bridging creative, media, and analytics teams.

  • AI fluency — you actively experiment with generative tools to speed up production, expand creative range, or improve output quality.

jobs.excerpt: Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities.
jobs.description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at .

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

The Role

We're hiring a Security & Compliance Analyst to run and strengthen our security, compliance, and governance programs across Peek.

You'll own day-to-day operation of our compliance programs, including SOC 2, PCI DSS, NF525, and accessibility, and various data protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA, CPRA…). You'll be the primary point of contact for auditors and a trusted partner to Sales on customer security reviews. You'll work closely with our DevSecOps Engineer: they own technical controls and remediation, and you run the program that shows those controls work.

You should have run audit cycles before and be comfortable driving work across teams independently. We don't expect deep expertise in every area. NF525 and accessibility, for example, can be learned on the job.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, DevOps, IT, Product, Sales, Legal, and external auditors to understand requirements, collect evidence, identify gaps, coordinate remediation, and help make security and compliance easier to operate at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own day-to-day operation of our compliance programs, including SOC 2, PCI DSS, NF525, GDPR, and accessibility.

  • Lead audit and certification cycles end to end as the primary point of contact for auditors: scoping, timelines, evidence, requests, findings, and remediation follow-up.

  • Own our compliance platform (Drata), keeping control mappings, evidence, and policies current.

  • Maintain and improve security policies, procedures, controls, and the risk register. Identify control gaps, recommend fixes, and drive remediation to closure with control owners in Engineering, DevOps, IT, Product, HR, and other teams.

  • Run periodic governance activities: access reviews, policy reviews, risk assessments, business continuity plan reviews and test documentation, and vendor security and privacy assessments, bringing in technical experts for higher-risk vendors.

  • Run our data protection program day to day: records of processing, data processing agreements, impact assessments for new features, data subject requests, and data classification and retention standards. Partner with Legal on breach assessment and notification.

  • Lead responses to customer security and privacy questionnaires and RFPs with Sales, and maintain a reusable answer library.

  • Coordinate accessibility compliance with Product, Design, and Engineering, tracking assessments, findings, and the remediation those teams own.

  • Report on program status, risks, and audit readiness to leadership.

  • Use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work such as evidence collection, control mapping, questionnaires, and reporting, including building AI-assisted workflows that help teams find accurate security answers.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3–5 years in security compliance, GRC, IT audit, risk, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting at least one SOC 2 Type II or PCI DSS audit cycle end to end

  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 trust services criteria and/or PCI DSS requirements

  • Experience with a GRC or compliance automation platform (Drata or similar)

  • Experience conducting vendor or third-party security risk assessments

  • Experience responding to customer security questionnaires or RFPs

  • A solid understanding of access controls, authentication, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, incident response, change management, and cloud infrastructure, enough to evaluate evidence and challenge control owners when needed

  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple work streams independently

  • Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, business teams, auditors, and leadership

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Drata

  • Accessibility standards such as WCAG

  • Familiarity with NF525

  • Working with SaaS products, cloud infrastructure, or engineering teams

  • Using AI tools or building AI agents and automations for security, compliance, or governance work

  • Familiarity with AI governance, particularly the EU AI Act and standards such as ISO/IEC 42001, and a view on how they apply to a company like Peek.

  • Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CIPP/E, or Security+

What We Value

A few things that will make you successful in this role:

  • Ownership. You keep track of the details, follow through, and make sure things don’t quietly fall through the cracks.

  • Curiosity. Security and compliance cover a lot of ground. We value people who are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet” and then figuring it out.

  • Pragmatism. Compliance shouldn’t exist just to check a box. We want controls and processes that reduce real risk and work for the teams operating them.

  • Clear communication. You can translate requirements into understandable actions and communicate effectively with engineers, auditors, customers, and business teams.

  • Continuous improvement. If a process is repetitive, confusing, or overly manual, you’ll look for ways to make it better.

Machine Learning Researcher

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation: Competitive salary in USD depending on experience and expertise.

About ImagineArt

ImagineArt is a fast-growing generative AI company building next-generation AI-powered creative tools. Our Machine Learning team is working on advancing generative AI and developing innovative models and technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible with AI.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Researcher who is deeply passionate about research, experimentation, and solving complex problems. This role is ideal for someone who doesn't just implement existing techniques but actively explores what is missing, what can be improved, and what should be built next.

The Role

As an ML Researcher, you will work closely with our Machine Learning team to identify research opportunities, investigate emerging techniques, and explore new approaches that can improve our AI capabilities.

You will be expected to independently explore research areas, identify gaps in existing work, evaluate the latest developments in ML and generative AI, and translate your findings into actionable recommendations for our engineering and ML teams.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys asking "What hasn't been solved yet?", "How can we do this better?", and "What should we build next?"

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth research into Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Generative AI.

  • Identify gaps, limitations, and opportunities in existing research and technologies.

  • Stay up to date with the latest research papers, models, architectures, and techniques.

  • Explore and evaluate new approaches that could improve our ML capabilities.

  • Analyze existing research and determine how it can be applied to real-world products.

  • Work closely with ML engineers and researchers to turn research ideas into practical solutions.

  • Propose new ideas, experiments, and directions for the ML team.

  • Design and conduct experiments to validate research hypotheses.

  • Review and benchmark existing methods and models.

  • Communicate research findings and technical recommendations clearly to the broader ML team.

  • Help shape the technical and research roadmap by identifying promising areas for exploration.

  • Contribute to building novel ML solutions rather than simply implementing established methods.


What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on research experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field.

  • Strong understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals.

  • Proven ability to conduct independent technical research and investigate complex problems.

  • Strong ability to read, understand, and critically evaluate research papers.

  • Experience identifying research gaps and proposing new approaches or solutions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to move from a research idea to experimentation and, where applicable, a practical implementation.

  • Strong communication and technical writing skills.

  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • A curious, highly analytical mindset with a genuine interest in exploring new ideas and pushing the boundaries of AI.

Ideal Candidate

You will be a strong fit if you:

  • Think like a researcher and are naturally curious about how things work.

  • Don't just follow existing solutions—you actively look for ways to improve or reinvent them.

  • Can independently explore a new research problem and identify meaningful directions.

  • Are comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended research questions.

  • Can identify what's missing in current ML approaches and explain what could be built to address those gaps.

  • Have a strong interest in emerging areas of AI and Generative AI.

  • Can collaborate effectively with ML engineers to turn research into real-world impact.

Why Join ImagineArt?

  • Work closely with a highly ambitious Machine Learning team.

  • Explore challenging problems in Generative AI and next-generation AI technologies.

  • Have the opportunity to influence what the team builds and researches next.

  • Work in a research-driven environment where new ideas and experimentation are encouraged.

  • Collaborate with engineers and researchers on impactful AI products.

  • Competitive compensation in USD.

  • Fully remote opportunity with an international team.

jobs.description:
Le contexte

La pression réglementaire — NIS2, DORA, RGPD, exigences SecNumCloud — transforme la sécurité en enjeu de direction générale. Notre conviction : la conformité n'est pas une contrainte à subir mais un levier pour construire des architectures plus solides.

Au sein de la verticale Cyber de notre practice, vous intervenez auprès de nos clients sur leurs sujets de gouvernance, d'analyse de risques et de mise en conformité, en lien direct avec nos architectes cloud et infrastructure. Cette proximité est notre différenciant : nous ne livrons pas un rapport, nous accompagnons la remédiation jusqu'à sa mise en œuvre technique.

Une practice en construction, et vous en êtes acteur. Notre practice est engagée dans une démarche de structuration, et la verticale Cyber est en pleine montée en puissance. Vous ne rejoignez pas une organisation figée — vous aurez la possibilité réelle de faire évoluer la practice, de construire nos offres GRC et de contribuer à structurer notre positionnement sur un marché en forte croissance

Vos missions

Gouvernance et conformité

  • Accompagner nos clients dans leur mise en conformité : NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, RGPD, référentiels sectoriels (HDS, PCI DSS, SecNumCloud selon les contextes)
  • Réaliser des audits et des évaluations de maturité, formaliser les écarts et construire les plans de remédiation
  • Rédiger et faire vivre les corpus documentaires : PSSI, politiques, procédures, chartes
  • Préparer et accompagner les certifications et les audits externes

Gestion des risques

  • Construire et animer les cartographies de risques, les plans de traitement et les indicateurs de suivi
  • Accompagner la gouvernance sécurité : comités, tableaux de bord, reporting à destination des directions

Lien avec la technique

  • Traduire les exigences réglementaires en exigences d'architecture, en lien avec nos architectes cloud et infrastructure
  • Contribuer à la conception de nos landing zones et référentiels avec la conformité embarquée par défaut
  • Participer aux plans de continuité et aux exercices de gestion de crise

Avant-vente et réponse aux appels d'offres

  • Participer à la rédaction technique de nos réponses aux appels d'offres : méthodologie, approche proposée, livrables, chiffrage
  • Défendre nos propositions en soutenance, y compris auprès de directions générales et de RSSI
  • Contribuer à la qualification des besoins clients sur les sujets de conformité et de gouvernance

Contribution à la structuration de la practice

  • Construire et faire évoluer nos offres GRC : audit de conformité, accompagnement NIS2/DORA, analyse de risques, mise en place de SMSI
  • Développer nos accélérateurs : matrices de conformité outillées, kits d'audit, modèles de livrables, référentiels de contrôles
  • Contribuer à la structuration de la verticale Cyber et à son positionnement
  • Animer la communauté cyber et porter la veille réglementaire de la practice

Le profil que nous recherchons

Diplôme et expérience

  • BAC+5, diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent.
  • Expérience : 8 ans minimum en cybersécurité, dont 3 ans sur des sujets GRC

Compétences techniques et méthodologiques

  • Maîtrise des référentiels : ISO 27001/27002/27005, NIS2, DORA, RGPD, guides ANSSI
  • Méthodes d'analyse de risques : EBIOS RM impérativement, ISO 27005
  • Conduite d'audits et évaluations de maturité
  • Compréhension solide des architectures techniques — cloud, infrastructure, réseau, IAM : vous devez pouvoir dialoguer d'égal à égal avec nos architectes
  • Connaissance des enjeux de sécurité cloud et des référentiels associés (CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM) appréciée
  • Anglais professionnel : nos contextes clients sont fréquemment internationaux

Certifications

  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor ou Lead Implementer appréciée
  • EBIOS Risk Manager, CISM, CISSP ou CRISC valorisées

Savoir-être

  • Capacité à porter un discours de conviction auprès de directions générales et de COMEX
  • Qualités rédactionnelles : vos livrables sont votre vitrine
  • Pragmatisme : nos clients attendent des plans applicables, pas des référentiels théoriques
  • Envie de construire : la structuration d'une practice demande de l'initiative autant que de l'expertise
  • Diplomatie et sens de la négociation, dans des contextes où la sécurité est souvent perçue comme un frein

Ce que nous vous proposons:

  • Un rôle qui dépasse la mission : contribution directe à la construction de nos offres GRC et à la structuration de la verticale Cyber
  • Une implication en avant-vente : rédaction technique des appels d'offres et soutenances client
  • Un positionnement stratégique, au contact des décideurs
  • Un budget formation et certification dédié
  • Une équipe où GRC et technique travaillent ensemble, et non en silos
  • Un marché porteur, sur lequel nous investissons
  • Un parcours d'évolution vers le rôle de référent de la verticale Cyber

« Notre développement international et notre position de leader sur le marché de l’Ingénierie et du conseil en Technologies nous confèrent une responsabilité sociale, sociétale et environnementale envers l’ensemble de nos interlocuteurs et parties prenantes », Simon Azoulay – Président Directeur Général d’ALTEN.

ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d’information technologiques.

About Darkroom

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Senior Paid Search Specialist - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don’t have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you'll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

  • Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.

  • Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.

  • Manage between 6-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 - $3M.

  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

  • Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.

  • Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

  • Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).

  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.

  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.

  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e-commerce equation.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.

  • Willingness and openness to learn and understand e-commerce P&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel —> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • 4+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).

  • 3+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative

  • Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results

  • Experience with all core e-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM)

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position. It applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. jobs.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom owns creator strategy for the brands we work with, and more of them now want a community behind it: creators, customers, and fans who post because they want to, not because a brief told them to. This role builds those communities from zero and runs them as a growth channel.

A community here is measured on what it produces outside itself: posts, content, referrals, and signups or sales. Most of our communities are tiered. A small inner circle of top creators gets money, early access, and a direct line to the brand. A larger ambassador tier gets access, perks, and first look at launches. Program tiers, like campus leaders or customer champions, run their own threads. And the open community is where everyone else joins. You decide how people get in, what each tier gets, what happens every week, and how activity turns into output.

This is a consumer role. The people in these communities are students, parents, professionals, and fans, and a community run like a support forum or a developer channel will not work here.

You report to a Director and work alongside the creator leads, the social team, paid media, and each client's product and brand teams.

This role is based in New York, working US hours, with travel for events.

What You'll Do

Build new communities

  • Choose the platform for each community (usually Discord, sometimes Slack, WhatsApp, Geneva, Circle, or a subreddit) and stand it up: channel architecture, roles and permissions, bots, onboarding, tier assignment, and moderation rules.

  • Set the entry rules and the offer for each tier with the creator leads and the client, such as free product for creators over a follower threshold, student access, or referral perks.

  • Build a proof channel before launch, where members show what the product did for them. It is the flex wall, and the best posts get reposted by the brand.

Run it every week

  • Welcome new members, assign tiers, and post open briefs in #briefs with a clear view of who claimed what and when it is due.

  • Run the 1-in-20 triage: find the post that popped, work out why, and brief the rest of the roster on it the same week.

  • Repost the top receipts and hand the best ones to the social and paid teams.

  • Give members a real line to the brand. Route product questions, feedback, and bug reports to the client's team and bring the answers back.

  • Monthly: an AMA with someone from the brand, program leaderboards, and a roster health check (who is posting, who has gone quiet, and what you do about it).

Launches and drops

  • Every launch lands in the community first. You run the sequence: inner circle, then ambassadors and program tiers, then everyone else, in step with the social team.

  • Get real conversation going in the first two hours. No copy-paste.

In person

  • Co-run creator events with the creator leads, such as pre-launch dinners, launch parties, and campus or pop-up activations. Recruit into the community on the spot, and make sure every event produces content.

Measure it

  • Report on each community as a growth channel: members by tier, weekly active share, proof posts per week, the share of ambassadors posting, and signups or sales attributed through community links and codes.

  • Write the SOPs as you go, so each program scales, transfers, and makes the next build faster.

What Good Looks Like at 90 Days

  • At least one community is live with tiers, onboarding, and moderation, ahead of a client launch.

  • The client's creator roster is in it, and the proof channel has a steady flow of posts from real use.

  • The weekly cadence runs through the Creator Associates. You are not the one moderating.

  • Community activity is tied to signups or sales in a view the client can read.

  • There is a written playbook the next community can start from.

What We're Looking For

  • You have built and run an online community for a consumer product, ideally one that grew fast. This is the most important thing on this list. Running a Discord at thousands of members is a strong signal. Moderating someone else's community is not the same thing.

  • You know what makes people post. You can say why one post gets reshared and another does not, and turn that into a brief other people can use.

  • Fluent in creator culture across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X, and comfortable with everyone from a college sophomore to a creator with a million followers.

  • Technical enough to own the setup yourself: roles, permissions, bots, onboarding flows, and automations.

  • You write like a person. You can hold one voice across a server, DMs, and a room.

  • Organized for volume: hundreds of people joining in a launch week, more than one community at a time, nothing dropped.

  • Calm when something goes wrong, like a product issue at launch or a creator complaining in public. You handle it and know what to escalate.

  • Comfortable with clients. You can explain what the community is doing for their business and push back when a request would hurt it.

  • AI-native. Our team works alongside AI for moderation, triage, analytics, and drafting, and you should be excited to build workflows with it.

  • Available for evenings and launch weekends when the community is most active, and able to travel.

Bonus Points

  • You launched a community or ambassador program for a consumer app, AI product, or DTC brand.

jobs.description:
At Hubtype we run as a lean, tech-forward company, so our Customer Success team plays a hybrid role that combines classic CS ownership with project management. Our CSMs are the single point of contact for the customer and are accountable for the successful delivery of each project, partnering closely with our engineering team, who handle the actual development work.

We are looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who will own the end-to-end customer journey: from kickoff and discovery, through implementation and go-live, to adoption, retention, growth and renewal. The role is not about writing code, but about understanding the customer's technical and business needs, translating them into clear requirements for engineering, and orchestrating delivery across teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of strategic accounts as their main point of contact across the full lifecycle.
  • Lead project delivery: scoping, planning, coordinating internal and client teams, managing timelines, dependencies, risks and deliverables.
  • Run discovery sessions with customers to understand business goals, use cases and technical context.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, structured requirements that engineering can act on, and translate technical decisions back into business language for the customer.
  • Act as the bridge between the customer and Hubtype's engineering, product and solutions teams. The CSM does not build the solution but owns its delivery.
  • Analyze customer data and project status to identify blockers, anticipate issues and surface opportunities.
  • Drive adoption, monitor account health and identify upsell and expansion opportunities.
  • Run QBRs, executive reviews, trainings and workshops with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Use AI tools daily to scale work: drafting, research, summarization, analysis, documentation and automation.
  • Capture customer feedback and feed it into the product roadmap.

Requirements

  • Mandatory to be based in Spain holding a valid Working Permit/Visa.
  • Mandatory Languages: full professional fluency in English, Spanish and Catalan, written and spoken.
  • Experience: 1–3 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting or Project Management in a SaaS / tech environment.
  • Technical understanding: able to confidently discuss APIs, webhooks, integrations, JSON, OAuth and SaaS architectures, and to follow technical conversations with engineers. The CSM does not need to code but must understand what's being built well enough to scope it, challenge it and explain it.
  • Requirements & analysis: strong analytical mindset; able to gather, structure and document technical and functional requirements, identify gaps, and break complex problems into clear deliverables.
  • Project management: proven track record managing complex delivery projects with multiple stakeholders, timelines and dependencies, coordinating engineering, product and client teams.
  • AI-native mindset (Level 3 maturity in Hubtype score): goes beyond using AI tools as a personal assistant. We expect someone who actively designs and builds AI-powered processes and workflows to make themselves and their accounts more efficient, automating repetitive work, scaling outputs, creating reusable prompts/playbooks, and continuously raising the team's AI maturity. Hands-on with ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, agents and automations.
  • Customer-facing communication: able to lead meetings confidently with executives, business owners and developers, and to adapt the message to each audience.
  • Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards and customer KPIs (adoption, NRR, CSAT, time-to-value); uses data to drive decisions and conversations.
  • Ownership & autonomy: thrives in a fast-paced, hands-off, async environment and gets things done without close supervision.

Nice-to-have / Plus

  • Additional languages: French at professional level.
  • Industry experience: background in conversational AI, chatbots, CCaaS, customer experience or messaging platforms.
  • Channels know-how: familiarity with WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Messenger, Apple Messages for Business or Google RCS.
  • Code literacy: ability to read code (JavaScript / Node.js, Python or similar) is a plus — not to write it, but to follow what engineering is doing.
  • Tooling: hands-on with Postman, Jira, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker or Tableau.
  • Environment: previous experience in a startup or scale-up.

Benefits

  • A role where you'll have lots of room to shine.
  • Working with amazing people from all over the world, with different cultures, experiences and knowledge.
  • 27 days of holiday per year, plus your birthday, plus a volunteering day, plus bank holidays.
  • Fully remote policy and very flexible working – we trust you to get the work done.
  • At Hubtype you’re expected to dedicate 10% of your time to self-improvement in the way you think it’s best for you. Whether it’s through online courses, side projects or reading books, that’s up to you.
  • Attractive Benefits & Perks Plan, centered in Learning & Development.
  • Workstation budget for make great work happen at home.

As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a resourceful Payer Contracting Specialist to accelerate our payer contracting efforts. This role will be a critical driver of expanding women’s access to Allara’s services across the country.

Being in-network on paper isn't the same as working in practice. Each new payer has its own written and unwritten requirements. You'll figure out what each new payer actually requires, how we need to work with them, and write it down so we never experience an issue we don’t need to. You'll run escalations to the root cause, and work with our teams to figure out solutions quickly. You'll keep our provider data clean so that applications are right before they go out the door, not after a payer sends them back.

That's this job. You'll be the person who finds the discrepancy, fixes it at the source, works the payer until it sticks, and writes down how you did it so nobody has to figure it out twice.

This is an early-career position with unusual breadth, but requires minimal experience and expertise. You'll touch provider data, payer policy, contracting, revenue cycle, and credentialing, which makes it one of the fastest ways to learn how healthcare payment actually works. There's a clear path into more complex payer relationships and ownership over time.

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Trabajas en ADIF o preparas sus oposiciones de Personal Operativo? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy, compatible con tus turnos, y ayuda a otros a entrar en ADIF.

🚆 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de ADIF

ADIF está en pleno relevo generacional y cada año convoca cientos de plazas de personal laboral fijo. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan el proceso por dentro para los perfiles de Personal Operativo.

📚 Perfiles para los que buscamos preparadores

  • Factor de Circulación de Entrada

  • Ayudante Ferroviario (Rama de Conservación y Vigilancia de Vía)

  • Montador Eléctrico de Instalaciones de Seguridad / Oficial Celador Línea Electrificada de Entrada / Oficial de Subestaciones y Telemandos de Entrada

  • Oficial de Telecomunicaciones de Entrada

  • Factor de Entrada

  • Oficial Administrativo de Entrada

  • Maquinista

  • Controlador

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Personal de ADIF que haya superado el proceso de ingreso y conozca el trabajo de primera mano.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en las oposiciones de Personal Operativo de ADIF.

  • Personas que dominen el examen completo: temario común, parte específica de su perfil (Reglamento de Circulación Ferroviaria, normas técnicas de vía, reglamentos electrotécnicos, telecomunicaciones, estaciones…), psicotécnicos e inglés.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad normativa muy técnica y motivar durante una preparación exigente.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

También buscamos especialistas en psicotécnicos e inglés A2 con experiencia en oposiciones ferroviarias: son dos de las tres pruebas del examen y cada una exige una nota mínima.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online del temario común y de la parte específica de tu perfil.

  • Reglamento de Circulación Ferroviaria y normativa técnica, explicados desde la experiencia real.

  • Psicotécnicos: entrenamiento con series cronometradas y análisis de errores.

  • Inglés A2 orientado al examen.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real.

  • Orientación sobre baremo de méritos y elección de perfil.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos, vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si trabajas en ADIF, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir, compatibles con turnos
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia en ADIF y qué perfil conoces.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido del temario o la resolución comentada de varias preguntas tipo test, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces ADIF por dentro y quieres ayudar a otros a entrar en el sector ferroviario, queremos conocerte.

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary Centellic is seeking a Customer Success Manager to join our New York-based Customer Success team.
jobs.description:
Position Summary
Centellic is seeking a Customer Success Manager to join our New York-based Customer Success team. This customer-facing role supports a portfolio of customer accounts and helps legal professionals maximize the value of Centellic's legal intelligence and information solutions.

The CSM will work closely with customers across the historic ALM portfolio, including Law.com, Law.com International, Law.com Compass, VerdictSearch, Law.com Radar, Law.com Scholar, and NewsVault. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, eager to learn, and passionate about helping customers achieve their business objectives through effective product adoption and engagement.

This role provides an excellent opportunity to build expertise in customer success, legal information products, and relationship management while supporting retention, customer satisfaction, and long-term account success.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Success Relationship Management
  • Support the management of a portfolio of customer accounts across the Law.com product portfolio.
  • Build relationships with customer stakeholders and serve as a reliable day-to-day contact.
  • Assist customers with onboarding activities and product adoption initiatives.
  • Help customers identify ways to incorporate products into their workflows and business processes.
  • Proactively engage customers to ensure a positive customer experience.
Product Adoption User Engagement
  • Promote usage and adoption of:
    • Law.com
    • Law.com International
    • Law.com Compass
    • VerdictSearch
    • Law.com Radar
    • Law.com Scholar
    • NewsVault
  • Deliver introductory product training sessions and support webinars.
  • Monitor user engagement and follow up with customers to encourage adoption.
  • Share product updates, new features, and best practices with customers.
  • Assist in creating customer communications and educational materials.
Account Support Customer Retention
  • Monitor customer activity and engagement levels.
  • Escalate customer concerns and potential renewal risks to senior team members.
  • Maintain accurate customer records and activity notes in company systems.
  • Collaborate with Customer Care, Product, and Sales teams to resolve customer issues quickly.
  • Support renewal efforts by helping ensure customers realize value from their subscriptions.
Customer Feedback Advocacy
  • Gather customer feedback regarding product functionality, content, and user experience.
  • Share customer insights with Product, Editorial, Marketing, and Sales teams.
  • Participate in customer surveys, feedback initiatives, and advocacy programs.
  • Help identify common customer questions and contribute to knowledge-sharing efforts.
Team Collaboration Professional Development
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, and Customer Care teams.
  • Participate in training and development programs to build product and industry knowledge.
  • Contribute ideas for improving customer engagement and onboarding processes.
  • Learn customer success best practices and develop consultative customer management skills.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

Required Experience
  • 1-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Account Management, Client Services, Sales Support, Hospitality, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Comfortable learning new technologies and software platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a desire to help clients succeed.
Preferred Experience
  • Familiarity with SaaS, subscription-based products, or information services.
  • Experience using CRM or customer success platforms (such as ChurnZero, Gainsight, or Plan Hat)
  • Interest in legal, professional services, research, media, or information products.
  • Experience delivering presentations, training, or customer support.
Key Performance Indicators
Success in this role will be measured through:
  • Customer engagement activity
  • Product adoption and utilization
  • Completion of onboarding milestones
  • Timely follow-up on customer requests and issues
  • Customer satisfaction feedback
  • Accuracy of customer records and account activity
  • Contribution to retention and renewal support efforts
  • Professional development and product knowledge growth
What Success Looks Like
The successful Customer Success Manager is viewed by customers as a helpful, responsive, and knowledgeable resource. Through proactive communication, strong product knowledge, and a commitment to customer success, they help customers realize value from Centellic's legal information and intelligence solutions while developing the skills necessary to grow into a senior customer success role.

About Centellic
Centellic stands at the center of the markets it serves, empowering organizations with indispensable data and insight to make critical decisions on growth, risk and opportunity.
Through proprietary data, deep market expertise and AI-enabled technology, our platforms are embedded in client workflows. That capability is underpinned by our events, which bring the market together to share perspective and deepen understanding of the issues shaping each sector. Together, they give organizations earlier visibility of emerging trends, and the clarity and confidence to act when decisions matter.
At Centellic, we’re a global intelligence and information services business, setting the standard for how critical business decisions are made.
Why Centellic?
At Centellic, we help our clients make better decisions, and our people are at the heart of that work. Every individual plays an important role in this, bringing curiosity and high standards to everything they do.
Those who thrive here take ownership, care deeply about their work and are committed to excellence. Standards are high because our people set them that way. And while we have decades of expertise, we are still growing, pushing and building something extraordinary.
Centellic’s advantage is our people and the culture we’ve created together. It’s an environment where individuality is encouraged, relationships are genuine, and there’s a strong sense of purpose in what we’re building together. Collaborative, respectful and driven, we take our work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.

Benefits

Our people are our most valuable asset, as such, we offer a wide range of benefits to help ensure that all are supported:
  • 15 vacation days, 12 company holidays, three personal days, one day to volunteer at the organization of your choice, plus a day off for your birthday each year
  • Choice of three Cigna health insurance plans, two dental plans, and vision coverage.
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flex Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Comprehensive wellness program
  • Employer paid life insurance
  • Employer paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Accident and critical illness insurance
  • 401K and Roth retirement savings plans with employer matching
  • Employee Referral Awards
  • Tuition reimbursement after 1 year of service
  • Commuter Benefits
The company is committed to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made, please let us know as part of our application page. If you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability, please contact Margo DeAngelo at 646-530-5941.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.﻿﻿

jobs.description:
Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by over 60,000 women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're hiring board-certified Internal or Family Medicine Physicians who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women with complex hormonal and metabolic conditions. This role is ideal for physicians eager to deepen their expertise in women's health. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit.

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments and develop personalized treatment plans via video visits

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care

  • Complete required trainings and uphold Allara's clinical policies, standards, and best practices

  • Educate patients on preventive care and wellness using evidence-based strategies

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and complete charting in a timely manner

  • Respond to patient questions and administrative messages with clarity and care

  • Dedicate a minimum of 10-20 patient-facing hours per week, depending on hiring needs, including consultations and medical guidance, with prescribing when clinically appropriate

Primary Clinical Focus

With a willingness to expand expertise across broader women's health care:

  • PCOS, Hypothyroidism / Hashimoto's, Metabolic Syndrome, Menopause / Perimenopause / HRT, PMDD, Obesity / Weight Management, Diabetes, Hyperlipidemia, and Anxiety/Depression (mild to moderate)

Required Qualifications

  • Degree: MD or DO from an accredited institution

  • Board Certification: Active national board certification in Internal or Family Medicine

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of consecutive clinical experience as an Internal or Family Medicine Physician with a focus on women’s health conditions (see Primary Clinical Focus)

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms, including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: Active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional licenses in one or more U.S. state(s) are required, and at least one must be in a state where we currently have an active hiring need. Multistate licensure, or eligibility to license across states through theIMLC, is required.

A note on state licensing: We hire against specific state-level needs that shift on an ongoing basis. All active and pending licenses, including IMLC- eligibility based licensure, are collected, reviewed, and kept on file. We regularly revisit applications as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

What Allara Offers

  • 1099 Contract: The flexibility and autonomy of an independent contractor arrangement

  • 1099 Longevity Recognition Bonus

  • Competitive Compensation: Per-visit rates plus additional pay for charting, administrative tasks, and other patient-related work

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set hours that fit your life, not the other way around

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to Visio Lending employees, shall be deemed the property of Visio Lending.

About Visio Lending

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home and vacation rental portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. With more than $400 million in capital onboard, a proven record of investment grade bond issuance on Wall Street, and an outstanding 100+ team, Visio is poised for continued success.

Why We Love Working at Visio:

We at Visio are passionate about working together towards our goals to continually push this company forward. We innovate, collaborate, celebrate team successes, and recognize individual accomplishments. At Visio Lending, you’ll work on meaningful initiatives that directly support real estate investors nationwide. We offer a collaborative culture, growth opportunities, and flexibility with remote work options.

How to Apply?

To be considered for employment, please submit your application online. While we appreciate all the interest we receive, only candidates selected for phone screening, or an interview will be contacted directly. You will receive application status alerts via email so make sure your email address is accurate.

Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Opportunity:

As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Visio Lending, you'll play a key role in supporting and enhancing the technology that powers our business. You'll troubleshoot complex technical issues, maintain and improve engineering systems, and work across software applications, data platforms, reporting, integrations, and internal tools to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.

This role is ideal for a technically curious problem solver who enjoys working across a variety of systems, quickly learning new technologies, and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve efficiency. You'll combine sound engineering judgment with emerging technologies to troubleshoot issues, automate repetitive tasks, improve documentation, support testing efforts, and accelerate solution delivery.

While this position is not responsible for defining Visio's AI strategy, you'll apply approved AI tools within established security and governance standards to enhance productivity and technical outcomes. A significant portion of the role will focus on supporting and improving our data warehouse, analytics, and reporting environments.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot production and development issues across software applications, data systems, reporting platforms, integrations, internal tools, and related engineering workflows
  • Maintain and troubleshoot data warehousing, analytics, reporting, and business intelligence systems, including SQL-based data analysis, ETL/ELT pipeline troubleshooting, and Power BI report/dashboard support
  • Use AI-enabled tools to assist with code analysis, debugging, SQL/query writing, test generation, documentation, requirements analysis, system design, data analysis, and technical triage, while validating AI-generated output before use
  • Read, understand, modify, and write code as needed in support of assigned engineering tasks, primarily using technologies such as Python, C#, SQL, and PowerShell
  • Assist with engineering projects across software, data engineering, reporting, Salesforce, Azure, APIs/integrations, DevOps/pipelines, and internal business systems
  • Work tickets from a helpdesk/ticketing system, including acknowledgement, triage, troubleshooting, resolution where possible, documentation of actions taken, and escalation when appropriate
  • Diagnose technical issues by reviewing logs, system behavior, API responses, data flows, configuration, permissions, user-reported symptoms, and related system evidence
  • Participate in deployments, releases, production changes, and validation activities following established approval, change management, and project procedures
  • Support monitoring, logs, alerts, and incident triage as part of the broader engineering team effort
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, support notes, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, runbooks, and system/process documentation
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, data engineers, analysts, software developers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify root causes, and implement practical solutions
  • Help reduce the operational burden on senior engineers by independently handling appropriately scoped troubleshooting, maintenance, documentation, support, and enhancement work
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, processes, automation, reporting, security posture, or technical support workflows
  • Support responsible and secure AI usage at the direction of the organization's AI leadership or designated AI manager
  • Other responsibilities and duties as assigned based on business needs
  • Authorized Remote Locations: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, NC, SC, TX, UT
  • Salary Range: $111,000 - $130,000 (Exempt level position)

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, data analytics, or a related field preferred, or equivalent demonstrable experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, systems analysis, technical operations, DevOps/support engineering, or a closely related technical role
  • Demonstrated technical background with the ability to understand software, data, application, integration, and infrastructure issues across multiple systems
  • Strong systems analysis skills, including the ability to investigate ambiguous technical problems, isolate likely causes, and communicate findings clearly
  • Ability to read and write code, with practical experience in one or more relevant languages such as Python, C#, SQL, or PowerShell
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query, validate, troubleshoot, and interpret structured data
  • Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and the ability to troubleshoot data pipeline failures, data quality issues, and data movement problems
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting Power BI reports, dashboards, datasets, or comparable business intelligence/reporting assets
  • Experience debugging APIs, integrations, logs, application errors, and data flow issues
  • Experience using Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or comparable source control and work management tools
  • Ability to participate in testing, deployment, release validation, and change management activities
  • Practical experience using AI tools in technical work, including code review, debugging, documentation, SQL/query support, analysis, and problem-solving
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated output critically and validate results before implementation or recommendation
  • Ability to work tickets in a helpdesk/ticketing system, document work performed, and escalate with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and context
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences

What We Prefer to Find:

  • Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly
  • Experience with Azure-based systems, data platforms, automation, or cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with data warehousing, analytics engineering, semantic models, reporting pipelines, or enterprise BI systems
  • Experience with Power BI report development, dashboard maintenance, dataset troubleshooting, or data model support
  • Experience with Salesforce administration, Salesforce development, Salesforce reporting, or Salesforce-related support workflows
  • Experience supporting production systems, including incident triage, root cause analysis, monitoring, logging, and post-incident documentation
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable release tooling
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Cursor, Replit, or prompt engineering frameworks
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to support engineers, analysts, business users, and technical leadership
  • Experience in financial services, lending, or regulated industries

Job Description

This position serves as the subject matter expert for web analytics, tag management, HIPAA-compliant data collection, healthcare privacy regulations, and digital performance reporting.

Working closely with web strategy, marketing, development, SEO, service line marketing, and third-party vendors, this role ensures accurate, actionable, and privacy-compliant analytics across MUSC's websites, patient acquisition platforms, marketing campaigns, and digital tools.

The Digital Analytics Specialist translates complex data into meaningful insights that support organizational goals, improve patient access, optimize digital experiences, and inform strategic decision-making.

Analytics Strategy & Governance (30%)

About the role

As Solution Architect, Medical Imaging, you'll define and govern the end‑to‑end architecture for medical imaging solutions across the product landscape.

Working remotely in the UK, in this newly created role your brief will be to ensure that applications, domains, and platform services integrate coherently to deliver scalable, reliable and compliant imaging workflows which support global clinical trials.

Deploying your combination of architectural experience and deep medical imaging domain knowledge, you'll translate product strategy and business objectives into solution‑level architectural direction, aligning multiple domains, teams and stakeholders around a unified technical vision. You'll be responsible for product‑wide architectural consistency, non‑functional requirements, security and regulatory alignment and technical risk management. Working closely with Product, Clinical, QA/RA, Security, Platform Engineering and Application Architects, your priority will be to guide architectural decisions which balance delivery efficiency, long‑term sustainability and business value.

jobs.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

A missão dessa posição é desenhar e construir soluções de arquitetura que traduzam as necessidades de negócio dos clientes em soluções técnicas robustas, escaláveis e seguras, atuando desde o assessment e definição da arquitetura até o acompanhamento da implementação nas squads.

A pessoa também será responsável por apoiar diferentes projetos da BU HIRE, orientar clientes em decisões arquiteturais e promover o uso estratégico das soluções Sensedia, APIs, integrações, cloud e IA.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Conduzir assessments de arquitetura, entendendo o cenário atual, as necessidades do negócio e as dores dos clientes.
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de APIs, microsserviços, integrações e soluções orientadas a eventos.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas utilizando os produtos Sensedia e tecnologias de mercado.
  • Participar de workshops, discoveries e reuniões de decisão com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Definir estratégias de segurança, governança, observabilidade, CI/CD e implantação.
  • Apoiar as squads durante a implementação, revisando códigos, contratos de APIs e configurações de gateway.
  • Elaborar diagramas, ADRs, roadmaps e guias técnicos.
  • Antecipar riscos, avaliar trade-offs e acompanhar as soluções até a entrada em produção.
  • Desenhar soluções envolvendo IA, AI Gateway, LLMs e arquiteturas agênticas.
  • Apoiar pré-vendas, RFPs e provas de conceito.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o desenvolvimento de profissionais mais juniores.
  • Atuar em diferentes projetos da BU.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência sólida em tecnologia, com atuação consistente em arquitetura de soluções e projetos de integração.
  • Domínio do desenho e do ciclo de vida de APIs REST, incluindo OpenAPI, contratos, versionamento, paginação, idempotência e tratamento de erros.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas de API Management ou API Gateway, como Sensedia, Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management ou WSO2.
  • Conhecimento aplicado de arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos e mensageria, como Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS ou Pub/Sub.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs e identidade: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, TLS/mTLS e gestão de segredos.
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes, incluindo operação e troubleshooting.
  • Domínio de pelo menos um provedor de cloud: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em ao menos uma linguagem backend, como Java, Kotlin, Go, Node.js, Python ou C#.
  • Experiência na condução de assessments, workshops, discoveries e conversas técnicas com clientes.
  • Capacidade de traduzir decisões técnicas para públicos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Entendimento funcional de LLMs, soluções de IA e arquiteturas agênticas.
  • Conhecimento dos principais riscos de segurança em IA, como prompt injection, vazamento de dados e autorização excessiva de agentes.
  • Uso fluente e crítico de assistentes de IA no trabalho de engenharia e arquitetura.
  • Comunicação clara, postura consultiva, autonomia, proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais a clientes.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com Open Finance, Open Insurance ou outros ambientes regulados de compartilhamento de dados.
  • Vivência em modernização de sistemas legados, decomposição de monólitos, Strangler Pattern e descomissionamento de ESB/EAI.
  • Conhecimento em Infrastructure as Code e GitOps, utilizando Terraform, Helm ou Pulumi.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, utilizando OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog ou Dynatrace.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados, CDC, data streaming e event sourcing.
  • Certificações AWS, Azure, GCP Architect, CKA, TOGAF ou de plataformas de API Management.
  • Experiência com pré-vendas, RFPs, provas de conceito e elaboração de propostas técnicas.
  • Vivência com AI Gateway ou LLM Gateway, incluindo roteamento de modelos, quotas por token, cache semântico, observabilidade e controle de custos.
  • Experiência com RAG e sistemas multiagentes em produção.
  • Conhecimento em LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel ou Spring AI.
  • Conhecimento de FinOps e otimização de custos de arquitetura.
  • Participação ativa na comunidade técnica por meio de palestras, artigos, eventos ou projetos open source.
  • Experiência orientando profissionais de arquitetura e desenvolvimento menos experientes.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)
