jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Hi!  👋 We are Ravelin!  We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems.
jobs.description:
Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.
And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity, and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.

If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.

The Team
You will be joining the Detection team, a team of data scientists and machine learning engineers. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low – and clients happy – by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error-free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible.

Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.

The Detection team is core to Ravelin’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Detection team. In this role, you will be setting the technical direction that bridges data science and engineering. You will be responsible for the architecture, scalability, and reliability of the high-performance ML systems that form the core of our fraud detection platform, with a critical focus on optimizing multi-GPU training for our foundational payments models (e.g., Transformers). Beyond just consuming data, you will take a leading role in defining how data is modeled, stored, and served, directly influencing the architecture of our feature generation pipelines and ensuring data quality throughout the ML lifecycle.
You'll take strategic ownership of our ML infrastructure, championing platforms and tools that empower Data Scientists to rapidly experiment with novel data inputs and model architectures. Your day-to-day will involve close collaboration with engineers and data scientists to operate and optimize machine learning at scale, while also providing mentorship and guidance to other members of the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and orchestration of scalable and reliable end-to-end ML pipelines – from raw data extraction and feature engineering to model training and inference.
  • Develop high-throughput data pipelines capable of handling terabyte-scale datasets efficiently and optimised for multi-GPU training of foundational transaction models (e.g., Transformers).
  • Propose and champion new machine learning methods and tools (including platforms that empower Data Science experimentation) to influence the technical roadmap and promote continuous innovation.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives with Data Engineering, Infra, and other teams to align on data architecture and ensure our ML systems meet overarching business objectives.
  • Evolve our MLOps infrastructure, driving the strategy for model versioning, automated deployments, monitoring, and observability using modern tools like Prefect.
  • Mentor and guide other members of the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.
  • Champion and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal tools and engineering best practices.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Qualifications

Job Description:

Job Title

Life Insurance Senior Underwriter – Fidelity Investments Life Insurance


Note: Fidelity is not providing immigration sponsorship for this position

The Role

Are you an experienced life insurance underwriter with a sharp eye for detail, deep understanding of risk assessment, and a passion for putting the customer first? Are you interested in applying your underwriting knowledge in new ways? We are seeking a dynamic and results oriented Life Insurance Senior Underwriter to join the research and development portion of our fast-growing underwriting team.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual with experience both in and outside of line underwriting looking to continue building their career. As a Senior Underwriter focusing on research and development, you will:

  • Aid in updating of underwriting guidelines and automated rules
    • Help identify key areas for refinement and prioritize updates based on overall impact
    • Research, draft and assist in the rollout of new underwriting guidelines
    • Conduct market studies to provide insight on industry norms
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on cross functional projects
    • Partner with the actuarial and data analytics team to evaluate business results data
    • Provide underwriting guidance to legal, risk and compliance teams as needed
  • Participate in audits
    • Review audit cases to ensure adherence to underwriting expectations
    • Conduct post issue studies of automated cases to confirm adherence to mortality expectations
    • Perform analysis of auditing findings to identify consistency gaps or areas of unintentional slippage and suggest ways to mitigate such findings
  • Assist with mentoring junior underwriters
    • Share in a collaborative team spirit where everyone pitches in to provide support and training to more junior underwriters
    • Aid in coaching of junior underwriters including in providing opportunities to explore areas outside of line underwriting

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

Bringing with you a Bachelor’s degree in an applicable field and 5+ years of progressive growth in life insurance underwriting, you possess a robust skill set in risk assessment. Your professional path has been defined by a commitment to cultivating deep expertise in case evaluation with an underwriting authority limit of $3,000,000 or higher, as well as expanding to roles outside of line underwriting. Experience with third party evidence providers, automated underwriting or industry designations are a plus.

The Team

Fidelity Investments Life Insurance is a team that is driven to provide customers with the financial security and peace of mind that comes from protection products like life insurance. Our team thrives on shared knowledge and mutual support across functional groups such as the actuarial and product teams. We foster an environment where open communication, professional growth and innovative thinking are highly valued. As a Senior Life Underwriter, you will play a pivotal role in providing the protection customers need while also contributing to the success of the company’s strategic goals.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $89,000-$180,000 per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career. Note, the application window closes when the position is filled or unposted.

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. This is a remote position.

Scope: Development of a book on Global Rights 45 years impact across the Globe.

Background:

Global Rights is a foremost human rights and governance capacity-building non-governmental organization (NGO) that has been operating for the past 45 years. The organization works at the intersection of the protection, promotion and fulfilment of human rights through good governance. We provide technical assistance and training to enable local partners to document and expose human rights abuses, conduct community outreach and mobilization, advocate for legal and policy reform, and provide legal and paralegal services.

As part of our efforts to document and showcase the achievements and impact of Global Rights, we are commissioning a consultant to interview stakeholders/partners and compile their stories into a book. Additionally, the book will be transformed into a vlog series to reach a wider audience.

Objectives:

  1. To document and highlight Global Rights’ achievements and impact over the past 45 years through the experiences and stories of former staff members, stakeholders and partners.

  2. To compile these stories into a compelling narrative that serves as a testament to Global Rights' dedication and contributions to human rights causes globally.

  3. To create a vlog series based on the stories gathered from former staff members, making the content accessible and engaging for a broader audience.

Scope of Work:

  • Conduct in-depth interviews with former staff members of Global Rights who have played significant roles in Global Rights' work over the years.

  • Capture personal narration, success stories, challenges faced, and the impact of Global Rights' initiatives from the perspectives of former staff members, partners and stakeholders.

  • Compile the insights gathered from interviews into a compelling narrative that reflects the ethos, achievements, and evolution of Global Rights as an organization.

  • Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and sensitivity in portraying the experiences and contributions of former staff members, partners and stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with Global Rights' communications team to develop a vlog series format that effectively translates the content of the book into engaging video content.

Deliverables:

  • A well-researched and written book documenting the achievements and impact of Global Rights over the last 45 years, based on the interviews.

  • A series of professionally produced vlog episodes that capture the essence of the book's content and engage viewers with the stories of Global Rights' work.

  • Any supplementary materials or documentation related to the project as required.

Please note that we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.


Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in conducting interviews, writing, and storytelling, particularly in the context of human rights or social justice issues.

  • Strong research and communication skills, with the ability to capture and articulate complex narratives in a clear and engaging manner.

  • Familiarity with video production or multimedia storytelling is desirable but not mandatory.

  • Sensitivity to cultural diversity and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality.

Timeline:The consultancy will be conducted over a period of 12 weeks.

Intellectual Property Rights:

All intellectual property rights arising from the consultancy will be the property of Global Rights. The consultant will not disclose or use any confidential information obtained during the consultancy for any other purpose without the written consent of Global Rights.

Confidentiality and Ethical Considerations:

The consultant will ensure that all data and information collected during the consultancy is treated with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with ethical principles. In particular, the consultant will ensure that data and information collected are stored securely and only accessible to authorized personnel. The team will also comply with relevant legal and ethical standards and report any ethical concerns or violations to Global Rights immediately.

Reporting:

The consultant will report to the Executive Director

  • Interested consultants are invited to submit a detailed proposal outlining their approach, relevant experience, proposed timeline, and budget considerations.

What Sets This Role Apart

jobs.description:
Engagement: Independent contractor
Working hours: 8 hours per week
Number of openings: 3

A long-established Caribbean conglomerate, operating across shipping, insurance, and retail, is expanding its accounting department through remote staffing. They're looking for accounting professionals with a strong accounting foundation, good analytical skills, and the ability to work accurately and accountably. Alongside the technical side, they value work ethic, professionalism, integrity, attention to detail, and meeting deadlines. The team works well with proactive, dependable people who take initiative.

You set your own hours. The team is in the Caribbean (GMT-4), so you'll need to be available for the occasional live call, but the day-to-day work isn't tied to their business hours.

About the role

We're looking for someone to maintain the accuracy and integrity of the company's financial records through reconciliation work, general ledger maintenance, month-end close, fixed asset accounting, intercompany accounting, and financial reporting support. You'll reconcile, investigate, and resolve assigned accounts on time, and the wider reporting process depends on completing that work on schedule.

You'll report to the Assistant Accounts Manager and the Accounts Manager. We provide full training on the company's accounting system, so we don't expect prior experience with their specific software.

What you'll be responsible for

The list below covers everything you could potentially handle in this role. It doesn't mean you'll be working on every item every week, and the mix will depend on where the department is in its cycle.

Bank and cash reconciliations

  • Preparing daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations

  • Investigating outstanding reconciling items and unreconciled differences through to timely resolution

  • Monitoring deposits in transit and outstanding payments

General ledger management

  • Preparing and processing journal entries

  • Reviewing account coding and transaction classifications

  • Maintaining the integrity of the chart of accounts and the accuracy of financial records

Balance sheet reconciliations

  • Reconciling assigned balance sheet accounts monthly

  • Investigating aged, unusual, or unsupported balances

  • Preparing supporting schedules and explanations for account balances

Intercompany accounting

  • Reconciling transactions between group companies and working with regional teams to resolve discrepancies

  • Making sure intercompany balances agree before month-end close

  • Preparing supporting schedules for intercompany transactions

Accounts receivable

  • Reconciling customer and supplier statements

  • Investigating posting errors, unapplied payments, and outstanding balances

  • Assisting departments with account discrepancies as required

Month-end and year-end activities

  • Preparing accruals and prepayments

  • Processing depreciation and amortization entries

  • Assisting with month-end and year-end closing activities

  • Preparing supporting schedules for management and audit purposes

Fixed assets

  • Maintaining the fixed asset register, including additions, disposals, and transfers

  • Calculating and reconciling depreciation monthly

  • Verifying physical assets as required

Internal controls and compliance

  • Making sure transactions comply with company policies and accounting standards

  • Identifying process weaknesses and recommending improvements

  • Assisting with internal audits

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field

  • An associate degree or accounting diploma may be considered where you have substantial relevant accounting experience

  • Progress toward a recognized professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent is an asset

Experience

  • Minimum three years in general accounting, account reconciliations, general ledger maintenance, or financial reporting support

  • Practical experience preparing bank, balance sheet, and intercompany reconciliations

  • Experience preparing journals, accruals, prepayments, depreciation entries, and supporting schedules

  • Experience assisting with month-end and year-end closing activities

  • Experience maintaining fixed asset records, an asset

  • Experience supporting internal or external audits

  • Experience working within a multi-company or group accounting environment, an asset

  • Experience using ERP or accounting systems and Microsoft Excel

Skills and competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including investigating aged, unusual, or unsupported balances

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • Able to prepare clear accounting schedules and explanations

  • Able to manage multiple assignments and meet month-end deadlines

  • Effective written and verbal communication, including resolving discrepancies with regional and intercompany teams

  • Professional working proficiency in English to collaborate with an English-speaking team

  • Able to work independently on assigned tasks while escalating unresolved matters appropriately

  • High level of integrity, accountability, and confidentiality

Bij Countus krijg je volop ruimte voor initiatief, ontwikkeling en impact.

Jouw impact als BI Specialist:

Als Senior BI Specialist bij Countus speel je een belangrijke rol in het verder ontwikkelen en implementeren van onze data- en BI-omgeving. Je zorgt niet alleen voor waardevolle dashboards en inzichten, maar bouwt ook mee aan de datafundering die hierachter ligt. Je werkt samen met business, IT en data owners en weet als geen ander hoe je data vertaalt naar oplossingen die echt waarde toevoegen.

Je belangrijkste taken omvatten:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van rapportages en dashboards met Power BI;
  • Ontwerpen en verbeteren van datamodellen en datawarehouse-oplossingen;
  • Ontsluiten en integreren van verschillende databronnen, zoals API’s, databases en cloudplatformen;
  • Bewaken en verbeteren van datakwaliteit, data governance en de betrouwbaarheid van onze data;
  • Analyseren van complexe datasets en deze vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare inzichten en adviezen;
  • Fungeren als stevige sparringpartner voor de business, IT en data owners;
  • Initiëren en begeleiden van verbeteringen en innovaties op het gebied van data, BI en data management.

Zie jij altijd kansen om dingen slimmer, beter en efficiënter te maken? Mooi, want als Senior BI Specialist krijg je volop ruimte om die kansen te benutten. Je neemt hierin een voortrekkersrol, brengt anderen in beweging en deelt jouw kennis met collega’s. Daarnaast werk je mee aan uiteenlopende projecten en initiatieven rondom data-integratie, datamigratie, datawarehousing en business intelligence. Kortom: een rol met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, impact en ontwikkeling.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare BI-, data- of analyticsrol en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van data en informatie. Je kijkt verder dan dashboards en vindt het juist interessant om mee te bouwen aan een betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige datafundering binnen het Microsoft data-platform. Daarnaast:

  • Heb je kennis van Python voor data-analyse, automatisering en datatransformaties;
  • Heb je ervaring met het ontsluiten van databronnen via API’s, databases en cloudplatformen;
  • Heb je kennis van SQL, Power BI, datamodellering, datakwaliteit en data governance;
  • Ben je een stevige en enthousiaste gesprekspartner voor zowel business als IT;
  • Denk je in mogelijkheden, neem je initiatief en werk je graag samen aan slimme en duurzame BI-oplossingen.

Wat bieden wij jou

Bij Countus Groep investeren we in jouw groei. Je krijgt volop de ruimte om je te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, kennisdeling en onze Countus Academy. Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal, in de richting die bij jou past.

Bij ons werk je vitaal, wendbaar en met plezier — met ruimte voor initiatief en balans.

Werken bij Countus Functioneel Beheer

Het team bestaat op dit moment uit 10 collega’s met ieder hun eigen expertise. De afdeling wordt aangestuurd door teamleider Henrieke. Er wordt hard gewerkt, maar ook hard genoten op z’n tijd. Job Summary:

As a Technical Solution Architect for ServiceNow, you will serve as the senior technical authority for the platform, translating complex business needs into scalable, resilient, and secure solutions. You will own the architecture, standards, and governance that keep ServiceNow performant and aligned with enterprise goals, partnering with stakeholders and delivery teams to design and guide implementations across the platform. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Solution Enablement.

Responsibilities:

As a Technical Solution Architect, you will be responsible for supporting the team in the following capacity:

  • Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for the ServiceNow platform, translating complex business requirements into scalable, resilient, and high-performing solutions.
  • Develop and maintain the platform roadmap, instance strategy, and technical standards spanning ITSM, ITOM, ITBM/SPM, ITAM (HAM/SAM), CMDB/CSDM, and custom scoped applications.
  • Create technical blueprints, solution designs, and reference architectures that align with the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and ServiceNow best practices.
  • Lead architectural decision-making and design reviews, ensuring solutions are secure, upgradeable, and sustainable over the long term.
  • Design and govern integrations using IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and ETL, establishing reusable patterns and standards.
  • Provide architectural oversight for AI-enabled and automation capabilities within ServiceNow, evaluating new features and Now Platform releases for fit and value.
  • Establish and enforce platform governance, including scoped application standards, coding standards, upgrade and release management, and performance engineering.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and Solution Analysts to assess needs, recommend optimal solutions, and contribute to Statements of Work with clear business and technical requirements.
  • Guide and mentor developers, administrators, and implementation partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on technical direction and code review.
  • Configure and prototype ServiceNow modules, workflows, and applications to validate designs and accelerate delivery.
  • Own the health and integrity of the CMDB and data model, ensuring accurate, well-governed configuration data across the platform.
  • Lead technical validation and testing activities, troubleshoot complex issues, and ensure successful deployment, adoption, and knowledge transfer.
  • Maintain comprehensive architecture, design, and configuration documentation to ensure operational clarity and accessibility.
  • Analyze existing processes and platform usage to identify inefficiencies, propose optimizations, and drive continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor on ServiceNow capabilities, guiding leadership on platform strategy and technology decisions.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 7+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, including 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow design, configuration, and implementation experience across multiple product lines.

Skills:

  • ServiceNow Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Now Platform, including ITSM, ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management), ITAM, and CMDB/CSDM, plus scoped application development.
  • Architecture & Governance: Proven ability to design instance strategy, platform standards, upgrade/release management, and performance engineering using industry-standard architectural frameworks.
  • Integration & Development: Strong command of integration patterns and standards (IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP, MID Server, ETL) and proficiency in JavaScript, Flow Designer, and related web technologies.
  • Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate complex requirements into pragmatic, scalable technical designs.
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project & Delivery Acumen: Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery and the ability to guide multiple concurrent initiatives from design through deployment.

Preferred Attributes:

  • ServiceNow Certifications: Certified Technical Architect (CTA) and/or multiple Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM) built on CSA and CIS – Data Foundations.

  • Traveling to manufacturing and distribution sites (~30%) for project-specific site visits — typical trips are 2–3 days

These are non-negotiable minimum requirements. Please review carefully before applying.

Experience — The Most Important Piece

    • Experience can be a combination (e.g., 4 years dedicated estimating + 6 years engineering) — but estimating must be a substantive part of that history
  • Proven experience with Class 3 and Class 4 estimation for Industrial and Manufacturing projects.
  • Experience estimating high-budget Industrial/Manufacturing projects valued $20million+
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. — no sponsorship is available for this role

Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering (any discipline) or Construction Management

  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard estimating software — tools like ProEst, Procore, RS Means, or comparable platforms (specific tools are flexible; you must have used professional estimating software)

  • Experience developing Scope of Work documents and reviewing approval vendors and contract bid packages
  • Experience with project management including coordination of cross-functional teams

Strongly Preferred:

  • Background from a general contractor, engineering firm, or construction management firm focused on capital/industrial projects
  • Industrial or chemical estimating experience is preferred over commercial or retail construction

Nice to have, but not required: Strong candidates without these are still encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Data Solution Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Accelerant Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers.
jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

About the Role

This is not a traditional enterprise architecture role.

Accelerant is operating in a period of rapid change. Significant internal systems across finance, operations, and data are being implemented. Business users across the organisation are building AI-enabled capabilities at a pace that exceeds the capacity of central engineering teams to review and govern them. The ways in which software is designed and built are themselves changing, with AI-assisted development and agentic tooling becoming part of everyday practice.

The Forward-Deployed Solution Engineer exists to respond to all of this in real time, from inside the teams doing the work, not from a distance.

This person is embedded with delivery programmes and product teams. They review decisions and code as they are made, not after the fact. They drive solutions quickly, make independent technical judgements, and hold the quality bar without becoming a bottleneck. They are the link between what the business needs to build and what can actually be operated and maintained at enterprise scale.

What You Will Do

Be present in the work

You will sit inside delivery teams for the duration of engagements, not alongside them. You will attend design and development sessions, review technical decisions as they are being made, and intervene when something is heading in the wrong direction. You will not wait for a review gate. You will be the engineering rigour in the room.

Validate and guide continuously

You will continuously assess whether what is being built conforms to Accelerant's architecture principles, data standards, and integration patterns. Where it does not, you will propose a better path and help the team take it. Where documented patterns do not yet exist, you will create them. You will not rely on others to produce the standard after the fact.

Take decisions quickly

You will be capable of making a sound technical decision on the day, with the information available, and moving forward. You will not wait for consensus where it is not needed. You will know when to escalate and when to act. The teams you work with will rely on your judgement.

Bridge business-built capability to production

Across Accelerant, business users are building capabilities using AI tools, low-code platforms, and scripting environments. Many of these capabilities are genuinely useful and represent Accelerant's direction of travel. Your job is to assess what has been built, understand what it actually does, identify the gaps between its current state and enterprise readiness, and create a clear path to production. You will ensure these solutions have appropriate data contracts, operational ownership, documentation, and supportability before they are relied upon by the business.

Own integration design

You will design and validate integration patterns between the enterprise systems Accelerant operates, including ERP, CRM, HR, and reinsurance platforms, and the data platform and applications that consume data from them. You will ensure that integrations are clean, well-documented, API-first where appropriate, and built to a standard that does not require the original designer to be present in order to be supported.

Drive data product quality and governance

You will work with delivery teams and the Data Office to ensure that data products are described at source, that ownership is clearly assigned, and that the canonical data models Accelerant depends on are accurate and accessible. You will understand the difference between a physical implementation and a logical data model, and you will be able to articulate why that distinction matters to the people building on top of these products.

Make knowledge durable

You will ensure that technical decisions are recorded, that architectural decision records exist and are accessible, and that the knowledge required to support what Accelerant builds does not live only in individuals. When you leave an engagement, the next person should be able to understand what was decided, why, and what the constraints were.

What You Will Not Do

You will not write lengthy architecture documents that no one reads. You will not operate as a governance gate that slows delivery without adding value. You will not wait for others to bring problems to you. You will not review things in isolation from the teams building them. You will not produce opinions without evidence.

Skills and Experience

Technical foundation

You have strong practical knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly Azure, AWS, and understand how enterprise applications are integrated, operated, and maintained at scale. You are comfortable with API design and integration patterns, including REST, event-driven architectures, and MCP-style tool connectivity. You understand data product concepts, lineage, ownership, and what it means to describe data at source. You can read and review code written by others and provide substantive feedback on it.

AI and modern development practice

You understand how AI-assisted and agentic development approaches are changing how software is built. You have practical experience with at least one AI development framework and understand the governance considerations that apply when AI-generated or AI-assisted capabilities are moved into production. You have a view on what makes an AI-enabled capability enterprise-ready and can assess a prototype against that standard.

Domain awareness

You have experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms, particularly in the finance, operations, or insurance domains. You understand how systems like ERP and CRM platforms model their data, why direct integration to application databases creates problems, and what a canonical data model is trying to solve. Experience with D365, Salesforce, or similar platforms is relevant.

Communication and delivery

You can communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders, and you adjust your register accordingly. You can explain a technical constraint to a non-technical audience without losing accuracy. You can challenge a technical decision in a room without making it personal. You are oriented toward delivery and you hold yourself accountable for whether things actually get done.

Ways of working

You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can engage with a problem that is not fully defined and make progress on it. You do not need complete information before forming a view. You are direct. You document your thinking. You are willing to be challenged and you welcome it.

What Good Looks Like

After six months in this role, the following should be true.

Delivery programmes you have been embedded with are running with fewer design-level surprises after build starts. Integration patterns you have reviewed or created are being used by other teams as a starting point rather than each team solving the same problems independently. Business-built capabilities that have come through your assessment have a clear production status, documented ownership, and a supportability record. Technical decisions made during your engagements are findable on Confluence and have enough context that someone new to the programme can understand them. The teams you have worked with ask for you to be involved earlier in their next piece of work, not later.

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy¿Trabajas en Renfe o preparas sus oposiciones?
jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Trabajas en Renfe o preparas sus oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy, compatible con tus turnos, y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza en el sector ferroviario.

🚆 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de Renfe

Renfe está incorporando miles de profesionales en los próximos años para asegurar el relevo generacional. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan sus procesos de ingreso por dentro y que puedan especializarse en una o varias de estas tres líneas:

Operador Comercial | Operador de Mantenimiento | Maquinista

📚 Líneas y perfiles para los que buscamos preparadores

🎫 Operador Comercial

  • Operador Comercial de Entrada N2

🔧 Operador de Mantenimiento

  • Operador/a de Entrada de Mantenimiento y Fabricación, en cualquiera de sus especialidades:

    • Ajustador-Montador

    • Electricidad

    • Chapista/Soldadura

    • Máquinas-Herramientas

    • Suministros

    • Mantenimiento de Material Rodante Ferroviario

No necesitamos un preparador por especialidad: si por tu formación y experiencia puedes cubrir una o varias, cuéntanoslo.

🚄 Maquinista

  • Maquinista de Entrada

Para acceder a este perfil se exige estar en posesión de la habilitación ferroviaria de conducción correspondiente, por lo que buscamos especialmente maquinistas en activo que conozcan el proceso por dentro.

¿Conoces otro perfil de ingreso de Renfe? Aunque nos centramos en estas tres líneas, también queremos conocer a preparadores de otros perfiles de ingreso de Personal Operativo. Indícanoslo en tu candidatura.

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Personal de Renfe que haya superado el proceso de ingreso en cualquiera de las tres líneas.

  • Operadores comerciales que conozcan la atención al cliente, la venta y el trabajo en estaciones y trenes.

  • Profesionales de mantenimiento de talleres y bases, con formación técnica en mecánica, electricidad, soldadura, mecanizado, logística o material rodante.

  • Maquinistas en activo con conocimiento del proceso de acceso y del trabajo en cabina.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en las oposiciones de Renfe.

  • Personas que dominen el proceso completo: psicotécnicos, temario, entrevista personal y, según el perfil, pruebas técnicas de su especialidad.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y motivar durante la preparación.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

También buscamos especialistas en psicotécnicos y en preparación de entrevistas con experiencia en procesos ferroviarios: el psicotécnico es el filtro eliminatorio de todas las convocatorias de Renfe.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu línea, especialidad y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online del temario de cada perfil.

  • Psicotécnicos: entrenamiento con series cronometradas y análisis de errores.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real.

  • Contenidos técnicos por especialidad para Operador de Mantenimiento.

  • Preparación de la entrevista personal.

  • Orientación sobre méritos y elección de perfil.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos, vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si trabajas en Renfe, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir, compatibles con turnos
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia en Renfe y en qué línea te gustaría preparar.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido del temario, de un aspecto técnico de tu especialidad o la resolución comentada de varios ejercicios psicotécnicos, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces Renfe por dentro y quieres ayudar a otros a conseguir su plaza, queremos conocerte.

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

Backend & Integrations

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

Çalışma saatlerini bu zaman aralıkları içerisinde planlayabilirsin. Ailelerin görüşmeleri açtığın saatlere göre oluşturulduğu için programına düzenli ve tutarlı şekilde bağlı kalman beklenir.

Genellikle bir hafta içi ve bir hafta sonu günü izin olarak seçilebilir.

💰 Kazanç Modeli

Bu pozisyonda toplam kazanç aşağıdaki bileşenlerden oluşur:

  • Sabit ücret

  • Satış komisyonları

  • Performans primleri

Haftada yaklaşık 20–25 saat çalışan ekip üyeleri genellikle aylık 30.000–50.000 TL aralığında kazanç elde eder.

Güçlü ve istikrarlı satış performansı gösteren ekip üyeleri ise 70.000 TL ve üzeri kazanca ulaşabilir.

Toplam kazanç; çalışma yoğunluğuna, gerçekleştirilen görüşme sayısına, satış performansına ve kıdem seviyesine göre değişir. Sabit ücret ve toplam kazanç potansiyeli, Kodland’deki kıdemin ve performansın geliştikçe artabilir.

Belirtilen tutarlar garanti gelir değil, mevcut ekip performansına dayalı kazanç aralıklarıdır.

🧭 Eğitim ve İşe Alım Süreci

Başarılı adaylar gerçek ailelerle görüşmeye başlamadan önce yapılandırılmış bir eğitim ve değerlendirme sürecinden geçer.

Süreç genel olarak:

  1. Başvurunun değerlendirilmesi

  2. Kısa online işe alım görüşmesi

  3. Bireysel çalışmalar ve canlı eğitim webinarları

  4. Pratik ve role-play oturumları

  5. Simüle deneme dersi değerlendirmesi

  6. Sözleşme, sistem erişimleri ve adaptasyon süreci

adımlarından oluşur.

Başvurudan ilk gerçek deneme dersine kadar geçen süre, eğitim planına ve adayın katılım hızına bağlı olarak yaklaşık iki haftadır.

🚀 Kodland Sana Ne Sunuyor?

  • Tamamen uzaktan çalışma

  • Sabit ücret, komisyon ve performans primleri

  • Hazır ders ve satış materyalleri

  • Kapsamlı eğitim ve adaptasyon süreci

  • Trainer, Team Leader ve ekip desteği

  • Uluslararası bir EdTech şirketinde deneyim

  • Satış, iletişim ve eğitim alanlarında gelişim fırsatı

  • Çocukların gelecekte kullanacağı beceriler kazanmasına katkı sağlayan anlamlı bir ürün

Requirements

✅ Zorunlu Gereksinimler

  • Kendine ait, güvenilir bir laptop veya masaüstü bilgisayar

  • Çalışır durumda kamera ve mikrofon

  • Zoom görüşmelerini kesintisiz gerçekleştirebilecek stabil internet bağlantısı

  • Kamera açık çalışmaya uygun, sessiz ve profesyonel bir çalışma ortamı

  • Haftada minimum 20–25 saat düzenli uygunluk

  • Hafta içi öğleden sonra ve akşam saatlerinde çalışabilme

  • Hafta sonunun en az bir gününde uygunluk gösterebilme

  • Türkçeyi akıcı, net ve güven veren şekilde kullanabilme

  • Çocuklarla ve yetişkinlerle rahat iletişim kurabilme

  • Online görüşmelerde enerjik ve profesyonel bir duruş sergileyebilme

  • Satış yapmaya, fiyat konuşmaya ve kayıt kararını yönetmeye açık olma

  • Hedef ve performans odaklı çalışabilme

  • Uzaktan çalışma düzeninde zamanını disiplinli şekilde yönetebilme

  • Bu rolü ana çalışma düzeni olarak sürdürebilme

🌟 Avantaj Sağlayacak Deneyimler

Aşağıdaki alanlardan birinde deneyim sahibi olman avantaj sağlar:

  • Satış veya danışmanlık

  • Müşteri hizmetleri veya çağrı merkezi

  • Eğitim, özel ders veya koçluk

  • Çocuklar ya da velilerle birebir iletişim

  • Uzaktan çalışma

  • CRM veya benzeri takip sistemleri

Bu deneyimlere sahip olman zorunlu değildir. Güçlü iletişim becerilerine, satış motivasyonuna ve öğrenme isteğine sahip adaylar da değerlendirilir.

🎯 Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olabilir, Eğer:

  • İnsanlarla konuşmayı ve ihtiyaçlarını anlamayı seviyorsan,

  • Çocuklarla iletişim kurmaktan keyif alıyorsan,

  • Satış ve performans sorumluluğu seni motive ediyorsa,

  • İtirazların satış sürecinin doğal bir parçası olduğunu biliyorsan,

  • Düzenli takip yapmanın sonuç almak için gerekli olduğunun farkındaysan,

  • Geri bildirime ve gelişime açıksan,

  • Çalışma programına istikrarlı şekilde bağlı kalabiliyorsan.

⚠️ Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olmayabilir, Eğer:

  • Yalnızca 09.00–17.00 saatleri arasında çalışabileceğin bir rol arıyorsan,

  • Akşam veya hafta sonu çalışmak istemiyorsan,

  • Satış yapma ya da fiyat konuşma konusunda rahat değilsen,

  • Kamera açık şekilde çalışmak istemiyorsan,

  • Performansının ölçüldüğü bir çalışma modeli sana uygun değilse,

  • Çocuklar ve velilerle birebir iletişim kurmak istemiyorsan.
